25817
25818template <int spacedim, typename Number>
25819template <typename Number2, typename Number3>
25820void
25821HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::Tvmult_task_parallel(const Number2 beta,
25822 Vector<Number> &y,
25823 const Number3 alpha,
25824 const Vector<Number> &x) const
25825{
25826 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<Number, Number2>());
25827 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<Number, Number3>());
25831 Assert(parent == nullptr, ExcInternalError());
25832
25833 if (property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric)
25834 {
25835 vmult_task_parallel(beta, y, alpha, x);
25836 }
25837 else
25838 {
25839 const unsigned int thread_num = data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads->size();
25840
25845 if (thread_num > 1)
25846 {
25847 // Set OpenBLAS num threads to 1 when task parallelization is used.
25848 const int blas_num_threads = openblas_get_num_threads();
25849 openblas_set_num_threads(1);
25850
25856 auto local_scale_and_multiplication =
25857 [this, beta, alpha, &y, &x](const unsigned int thread_no) -> void {
25861 for (size_type i =
25862 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25863 .tvmult_result_index_range[0];
25864 i < (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25865 .tvmult_result_index_range[1];
25866 i++)
25867 {
25868 y[i] *= beta;
25869 }
25870
25874 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25875 .local_tvmult_result = Number(0.);
25876 if (this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric)
25877 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25878 .local_vmult_result = Number(0.);
25879
25884 for (unsigned int l =
25885 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25886 .leaf_set_interval.first;
25887 l <= (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25888 .leaf_set_interval.second;
25889 l++)
25890 {
25891 const size_type m = this->leaf_set[l]->m;
25892 const size_type n = this->leaf_set[l]->n;
25893
25894 Vector<Number> local_y_for_Tvmult(n);
25895 Vector<Number> local_x_for_Tvmult(m);
25896
25900 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
25901 {
25902 local_x_for_Tvmult(i) =
25903 x((*this->leaf_set[l]->row_index_range)[0] + i);
25904 }
25905
25906 switch (this->leaf_set[l]->type)
25907 {
25908 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
25909 this->leaf_set[l]->fullmatrix->Tvmult(
25910 local_y_for_Tvmult, local_x_for_Tvmult);
25911
25912 break;
25913 }
25914 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
25915 this->leaf_set[l]->rkmatrix->Tvmult(local_y_for_Tvmult,
25916 local_x_for_Tvmult);
25917
25918 break;
25919 }
25920 default: {
25921 Assert(false,
25922 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(this->leaf_set[l]->type));
25923
25924 break;
25925 }
25926 }
25927
25933 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
25934 {
25935 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25936 .local_tvmult_result(
25937 (*this->leaf_set[l]->col_index_range)[0] -
25938 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25939 .local_tvmult_result_index_range[0] +
25940 j) += alpha * local_y_for_Tvmult(j);
25941 }
25942
25943 if (this->property ==
25944 HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric &&
25945 this->leaf_set[l]->block_type ==
25946 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
25947 {
25952 Vector<Number> local_y(m);
25953 Vector<Number> local_x(n);
25954
25958 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
25959 {
25960 local_x(j) =
25961 x((*this->leaf_set[l]->col_index_range)[0] + j);
25962 }
25963
25964 switch (this->leaf_set[l]->type)
25965 {
25966 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
25967 this->leaf_set[l]->fullmatrix->Cvmult(local_y,
25968 local_x);
25969
25970 break;
25971 }
25972 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
25973 this->leaf_set[l]->rkmatrix->Cvmult(local_y,
25974 local_x);
25975
25976 break;
25977 }
25978 default: {
25979 Assert(false,
25980 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(
25981 this->leaf_set[l]->type));
25982
25983 break;
25984 }
25985 }
25986
25992 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
25993 {
25994 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25995 .local_vmult_result(
25996 (*this->leaf_set[l]->row_index_range)[0] -
25997 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
25998 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0] +
25999 i) += alpha * local_y(i);
26000 }
26001 }
26002 }
26003 };
26004
26005 Threads::TaskGroup<void> local_scaling_and_multiplication_tasks;
26006 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
26007 {
26008 local_scaling_and_multiplication_tasks +=
26009 Threads::new_task(std::bind(local_scale_and_multiplication, i));
26010 }
26011
26012 local_scaling_and_multiplication_tasks.join_all();
26013
26014 auto assemble_contribution_from_all_threads =
26015 [this, &y](const unsigned int thread_no) -> void {
26016 unsigned int other_thread_no = 0;
26017 for (const auto &range_intersection :
26018 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
26019 .tvmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads)
26020 {
26021 for (size_type i = range_intersection[0];
26022 i < range_intersection[1];
26023 i++)
26024 {
26025 y(i) +=
26026 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[other_thread_no]
26027 .local_tvmult_result(
26028 i - (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
26029 [other_thread_no]
26030 .local_tvmult_result_index_range[0]);
26031 }
26032
26033 other_thread_no++;
26034 }
26035
26036 if (this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric)
26037 {
26038 unsigned int other_thread_no = 0;
26039 for (
26040 const auto &range_intersection :
26041 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
26042 .vmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads)
26043 {
26044 for (size_type i = range_intersection[0];
26045 i < range_intersection[1];
26046 i++)
26047 {
26048 y(i) +=
26049 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
26050 [other_thread_no]
26051 .local_vmult_result(
26052 i - (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
26053 [other_thread_no]
26054 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0]);
26055 }
26056
26057 other_thread_no++;
26058 }
26059 }
26060 };
26061
26062 Threads::TaskGroup<void> assembly_tasks;
26063 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
26064 {
26065 assembly_tasks += Threads::new_task(
26066 std::bind(assemble_contribution_from_all_threads, i));
26067 }
26068
26069 assembly_tasks.join_all();
26070
26071 // Restore the original OpenBLAS num threads.
26072 openblas_set_num_threads(blas_num_threads);
26073 }
26074 else
26075 {
26076 Tvmult_serial_iterative(beta, y, alpha, x);
26077 }
26078 }
26079}

27101 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(property));
27102
27103 Vector<Number> local_y(n);
27104 Vector<Number> local_x(m);
27105
27109 for (size_type j = 0; j < m; j++)
27110 {
27111 local_x(j) = x((*row_index_range)[0] + j);
27112 }
27113
27114 rkmatrix->Hvmult(local_y, local_x);
27115
27119 for (size_type i = 0; i < n; i++)
27120 {
27121 y((*col_index_range)[0] + i) +=
27122 alpha * local_y(i);
27123 }
27124
27125 break;
27126 }
27127 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::
27128 lower_triangular_block: {
27133 break;
27134 }
27135 default: {
27136 throw(ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
27137
27138 break;
27139 }
27140 }
27141
27142 break;
27143 }
27144 default: {
27145 throw(ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(top_hmat_property));
27146
27147 break;
27148 }
27149 }
27150
27151 break;
27152 }
27153 case UndefinedMatrixType:
27154 default: {
27155 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
27156 break;
27157 }
27158 }
27159 }
27160 else
27161 {
27162 this->Tvmult(y, alpha, x, top_hmat_property);
27163 }
27164}

27174{
27175 Hvmult(y, real_type(1.0), x, starting_hmat, top_hmat_property);

28244
28245template <int spacedim, typename Number>
28246template <typename Number2, typename Number3>
28247void
28248HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::Hvmult_serial_iterative(
28249 const Number2 beta,
28250 Vector<Number> &y,
28251 const Number3 alpha,
28252 const Vector<Number> &x) const
28253{
28254 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<Number, Number2>());
28255 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<Number, Number3>());
28259 Assert(parent == nullptr, ExcInternalError());
28260
28261 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<Number>::is_complex)
28262 {
28263 if (property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric)
28264 {
28265 vmult_serial_iterative(beta, y, alpha, x);
28266 }
28267 else
28268 {
28272 y *= beta;
28273
28277 for (size_type l = 0; l < leaf_set.size(); l++)
28278 {
28279 const size_type m = this->leaf_set[l]->m;
28280 const size_type n = this->leaf_set[l]->n;
28281
28282 Vector<Number> local_y_for_Hvmult(n);
28283 Vector<Number> local_x_for_Hvmult(m);
28284
28289 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
28290 {
28291 local_x_for_Hvmult(i) =
28292 x((*this->leaf_set[l]->row_index_range)[0] + i);
28293 }
28294
28295 switch (this->leaf_set[l]->type)
28296 {
28297 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
28298 this->leaf_set[l]->fullmatrix->Hvmult(local_y_for_Hvmult,
28299 local_x_for_Hvmult);
28300
28301 break;
28302 }
28303 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
28304 this->leaf_set[l]->rkmatrix->Hvmult(local_y_for_Hvmult,
28305 local_x_for_Hvmult);
28306
28307 break;
28308 }
28309 default: {
28310 Assert(false,
28311 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(this->leaf_set[l]->type));
28312
28313 break;
28314 }
28315 }
28316
28321 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
28322 {
28323 y((*this->leaf_set[l]->col_index_range)[0] + j) +=
28324 alpha * local_y_for_Hvmult(j);
28325 }
28326
28327 if (this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric &&
28328 this->leaf_set[l]->block_type ==
28329 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
28330 {
28335 Vector<Number> local_y(m);
28336 Vector<Number> local_x(n);
28337
28341 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
28342 {
28343 local_x(j) =
28344 x((*this->leaf_set[l]->col_index_range)[0] + j);
28345 }
28346
28347 switch (this->leaf_set[l]->type)
28348 {
28349 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
28350 this->leaf_set[l]->fullmatrix->Cvmult(local_y,
28351 local_x);
28352
28353 break;
28354 }
28355 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
28356 this->leaf_set[l]->rkmatrix->Cvmult(local_y, local_x);
28357
28358 break;
28359 }
28360 default: {
28361 Assert(false,
28362 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(
28363 this->leaf_set[l]->type));
28364
28365 break;
28366 }
28367 }
28368
28372 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
28373 {
28374 y((*this->leaf_set[l]->row_index_range)[0] + i) +=
28375 alpha * local_y(i);
28376 }
28377 }
28378 }
28379 }
28380 }
28381 else
28382 {
28383 this->Tvmult_serial_iterative(beta, y, alpha, x);
28384 }
28385}
28386
28387
28388template <int spacedim, typename Number>
28389template <typename Number2, typename Number3>
28390void
28391HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::Hvmult_task_parallel(const Number2 beta,
28392 Vector<Number> &y,
28393 const Number3 alpha,
28394 const Vector<Number> &x) const
28395{
28396 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<Number, Number2>());
28397 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<Number, Number3>());
28401 Assert(parent == nullptr, ExcInternalError());
28402
28403 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<Number>::is_complex)
28404 {
28405 if (property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric)
28406 {
28407 vmult_task_parallel(beta, y, alpha, x);
28408 }
28409 else
28410 {
28411 const unsigned int thread_num =
28412 data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads->size();
28413
28418 if (thread_num > 1)
28419 {
28420 // Set OpenBLAS num threads to 1 when task parallelization is
28421 // used.
28422 const int blas_num_threads = openblas_get_num_threads();
28423 openblas_set_num_threads(1);
28424
28430 auto local_scale_and_multiplication =
28431 [this, beta, alpha, &y, &x](
28432 const unsigned int thread_no) -> void {
28436 for (size_type i =
28437 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28438 .tvmult_result_index_range[0];
28439 i < (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28440 .tvmult_result_index_range[1];
28441 i++)
28442 {
28443 y[i] *= beta;
28444 }
28445
28450 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28451 .local_tvmult_result = Number(0.);
28452 if (this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric)
28453 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28454 .local_vmult_result = Number(0.);
28455
28460 for (unsigned int l =
28461 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28462 .leaf_set_interval.first;
28463 l <= (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28464 .leaf_set_interval.second;
28465 l++)
28466 {
28467 const size_type m = this->leaf_set[l]->m;
28468 const size_type n = this->leaf_set[l]->n;
28469
28470 Vector<Number> local_y_for_Hvmult(n);
28471 Vector<Number> local_x_for_Hvmult(m);
28472
28476 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
28477 {
28478 local_x_for_Hvmult(i) =
28479 x((*this->leaf_set[l]->row_index_range)[0] + i);
28480 }
28481
28482 switch (this->leaf_set[l]->type)
28483 {
28484 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
28485 this->leaf_set[l]->fullmatrix->Hvmult(
28486 local_y_for_Hvmult, local_x_for_Hvmult);
28487
28488 break;
28489 }
28490 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
28491 this->leaf_set[l]->rkmatrix->Hvmult(
28492 local_y_for_Hvmult, local_x_for_Hvmult);
28493
28494 break;
28495 }
28496 default: {
28497 Assert(false,
28498 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(
28499 this->leaf_set[l]->type));
28500
28501 break;
28502 }
28503 }
28504
28510 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
28511 {
28512 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28513 .local_tvmult_result(
28514 (*this->leaf_set[l]->col_index_range)[0] -
28515 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28516 .local_tvmult_result_index_range[0] +
28517 j) += alpha * local_y_for_Hvmult(j);
28518 }
28519
28520 if (this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric &&
28521 this->leaf_set[l]->block_type ==
28522 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
28523 {
28528 Vector<Number> local_y(m);
28529 Vector<Number> local_x(n);
28530
28534 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
28535 {
28536 local_x(j) =
28537 x((*this->leaf_set[l]->col_index_range)[0] + j);
28538 }
28539
28540 switch (this->leaf_set[l]->type)
28541 {
28542 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
28543 this->leaf_set[l]->fullmatrix->Cvmult(local_y,
28544 local_x);
28545
28546 break;
28547 }
28548 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
28549 this->leaf_set[l]->rkmatrix->Cvmult(local_y,
28550 local_x);
28551
28552 break;
28553 }
28554 default: {
28555 Assert(false,
28556 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(
28557 this->leaf_set[l]->type));
28558
28559 break;
28560 }
28561 }
28562
28568 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
28569 {
28570 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28571 .local_vmult_result(
28572 (*this->leaf_set[l]->row_index_range)[0] -
28573 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
28574 [thread_no]
28575 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0] +
28576 i) += alpha * local_y(i);
28577 }
28578 }
28579 }
28580 };
28581
28582 Threads::TaskGroup<void> local_scaling_and_multiplication_tasks;
28583 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
28584 {
28585 local_scaling_and_multiplication_tasks += Threads::new_task(
28586 std::bind(local_scale_and_multiplication, i));
28587 }
28588
28589 local_scaling_and_multiplication_tasks.join_all();
28590
28591 auto assemble_contribution_from_all_threads =
28592 [this, &y](const unsigned int thread_no) -> void {
28593 unsigned int other_thread_no = 0;
28594 for (
28595 const auto &range_intersection :
28596 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28597 .tvmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads)
28598 {
28599 for (size_type i = range_intersection[0];
28600 i < range_intersection[1];
28601 i++)
28602 {
28603 y(i) +=
28604 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
28605 [other_thread_no]
28606 .local_tvmult_result(
28607 i - (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
28608 [other_thread_no]
28609 .local_tvmult_result_index_range[0]);
28610 }
28611
28612 other_thread_no++;
28613 }
28614
28615 if (this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric)
28616 {
28617 unsigned int other_thread_no = 0;
28618 for (
28619 const auto &range_intersection :
28620 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
28621 .vmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads)
28622 {
28623 for (size_type i = range_intersection[0];
28624 i < range_intersection[1];
28625 i++)
28626 {
28627 y(i) +=
28628 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
28629 [other_thread_no]
28630 .local_vmult_result(
28631 i -
28632 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)
28633 [other_thread_no]
28634 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0]);
28635 }
28636
28637 other_thread_no++;
28638 }
28639 }
28640 };
28641
28642 Threads::TaskGroup<void> assembly_tasks;
28643 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
28644 {
28645 assembly_tasks += Threads::new_task(
28646 std::bind(assemble_contribution_from_all_threads, i));
28647 }
28648
28649 assembly_tasks.join_all();
28650
28651 // Restore the original OpenBLAS num threads.
28652 openblas_set_num_threads(blas_num_threads);
28653 }
28654 else
28655 {
28656 Hvmult_serial_iterative(beta, y, alpha, x);
28657 }
28658 }
28659 }
28660 else
28661 {
28662 Tvmult_task_parallel(beta, y, alpha, x);
28663 }
28664}

28727template <int spacedim, typename Number>
28728void
28729HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::h_h_mmult_reduction()
28730{
28731 std::vector<
28732 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>>
28733 Sigma_P_cannot_reduced;
28734
28735 while (Sigma_P.size() > 0)
28736 {
28737 // Get the last element in the list.
28738 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
28739 &hmat_pair = Sigma_P.back();
28740 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *M1 = hmat_pair.first;
28741 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *M2 = hmat_pair.second;
28742
28747 if (M1->type == RkMatrixType)
28748 {
28749 rk_h_mmult_for_h_h_mmult(M1, M2, this);
28750 }
28751 else if (M2->type == RkMatrixType)
28752 {
28753 h_rk_mmult_for_h_h_mmult(M1, M2, this);
28754 }
28755 else if (M1->type == FullMatrixType)
28756 {
28757 f_h_mmult_for_h_h_mmult(M1, M2, this);
28758 }
28759 else if (M2->type == FullMatrixType)
28760 {
28761 h_f_mmult_for_h_h_mmult(M1, M2, this);
28762 }
28763 else if (M1->bc_node->get_split_mode() == VerticalSplitMode &&
28764 M2->bc_node->get_split_mode() == HorizontalSplitMode)
28765 {
28766 // Internal splitting
28767 Sigma_P.pop_back();
28768
28769 Assert(M1->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28770 Assert(M2->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28771 Sigma_P.push_back(
28772 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28773 M1->submatrices[0], M2->submatrices[0]));
28774
28775 Assert(M1->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28776 Assert(M2->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28777 Sigma_P.push_back(
28778 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28779 M1->submatrices[1], M2->submatrices[1]));
28780 }
28781 else
28782 {
28787 Sigma_P_cannot_reduced.push_back(hmat_pair);
28793 Sigma_P.pop_back();
28794 }
28795 }
28796
28801 for (std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
28802 hmat_pair : Sigma_P_cannot_reduced)
28803 {
28804 Sigma_P.push_back(hmat_pair);
28805 }
28806}

28809template <int spacedim, typename Number>
28810void
28811HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::h_h_mmult_horizontal_split(
28812 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bc_tree)
28813{
28817 split_block_cluster_node(bc_node, bc_tree, HorizontalSplitMode);
28818
28819 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat0 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
28820 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat0, bc_node->get_child_pointer(0));
28825 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat0);
28826
28827 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat1 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
28828 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat1, bc_node->get_child_pointer(1));
28833 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat1);
28834
28838 while (Sigma_P.size() > 0)
28839 {
28840 // Get the last element in the list.
28841 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
28842 &hmat_pair = Sigma_P.back();
28843
28848 if (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == HorizontalSplitMode &&
28849 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == UnsplitMode)
28850 {
28851 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28852 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
28853 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28854 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0], hmat_pair.second));
28855
28856 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28857 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
28858 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28859 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1], hmat_pair.second));
28860
28865 Sigma_P.pop_back();
28866 }
28867 else if (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode &&
28868 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
28869 HorizontalSplitMode)
28870 {
28871 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28872 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28873 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
28874 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28875 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
28876 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
28877
28878 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28879 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28880 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
28881 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28882 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
28883 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
28884
28885 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[2], ExcInternalError());
28886 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
28887 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28888 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[2],
28889 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
28890
28891 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[3], ExcInternalError());
28892 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
28893 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28894 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[3],
28895 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
28896
28901 Sigma_P.pop_back();
28902 }
28903 else
28904 {
28905 Assert(false, ExcInternalError());
28906 }
28907 }
28908
28913 type = HierarchicalMatrixType;
28914}

28917template <int spacedim, typename Number>
28918void
28919HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::h_h_mmult_vertical_split(
28920 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bc_tree)
28921{
28925 split_block_cluster_node(bc_node, bc_tree, VerticalSplitMode);
28926
28927 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat0 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
28928 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat0, bc_node->get_child_pointer(0));
28933 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat0);
28934
28935 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat1 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
28936 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat1, bc_node->get_child_pointer(1));
28941 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat1);
28942
28946 while (Sigma_P.size() > 0)
28947 {
28948 // Get the last element in the list.
28949 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
28950 &hmat_pair = Sigma_P.back();
28951
28956 if (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == UnsplitMode &&
28957 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == VerticalSplitMode)
28958 {
28959 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28960 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
28961 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28962 hmat_pair.first, hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
28963
28964 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28965 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
28966 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28967 hmat_pair.first, hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
28968
28973 Sigma_P.pop_back();
28974 }
28975 else if (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
28976 VerticalSplitMode &&
28977 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode)
28978 {
28979 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28980 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
28981 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
28982 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28983 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
28984 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
28985
28986 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28987 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[2], ExcInternalError());
28988 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
28989 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28990 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
28991 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[2]));
28992
28993 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
28994 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
28995 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
28996 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
28997 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
28998
28999 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[3], ExcInternalError());
29000 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
29001 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29002 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
29003 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[3]));
29004
29009 Sigma_P.pop_back();
29010 }
29011 else
29012 {
29013 Assert(false, ExcInternalError());
29014 }
29015 }
29016
29021 type = HierarchicalMatrixType;
29022}

29025template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29026void
29027HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::h_h_mmult_cross_split(
29028 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bc_tree)
29029{
29033 split_block_cluster_node(bc_node, bc_tree, CrossSplitMode);
29034
29035 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat0 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
29036 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat0, bc_node->get_child_pointer(0));
29041 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat0);
29042
29043 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat1 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
29044 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat1, bc_node->get_child_pointer(1));
29049 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat1);
29050
29051 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat2 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
29052 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat2, bc_node->get_child_pointer(2));
29057 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat2);
29058
29059 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *child_hmat3 = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>();
29060 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(*child_hmat3, bc_node->get_child_pointer(3));
29065 submatrices.push_back(child_hmat3);
29066
29070 while (Sigma_P.size() > 0)
29071 {
29072 // Get the last element in the list.
29073 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
29074 &hmat_pair = Sigma_P.back();
29075
29080 if (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode &&
29081 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode)
29082 {
29088 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
29089 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
29090 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
29091 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29092 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
29093 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
29094
29095 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
29096 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[2], ExcInternalError());
29097 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
29098 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29099 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
29100 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[2]));
29101
29107 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
29108 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
29109 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29110 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
29111 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
29112
29113 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[3], ExcInternalError());
29114 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
29115 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29116 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
29117 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[3]));
29118
29124 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[2], ExcInternalError());
29125 child_hmat2->Sigma_P.push_back(
29126 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29127 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[2],
29128 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
29129
29130 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[3], ExcInternalError());
29131 child_hmat2->Sigma_P.push_back(
29132 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29133 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[3],
29134 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[2]));
29135
29141 child_hmat3->Sigma_P.push_back(
29142 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29143 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[2],
29144 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
29145
29146 child_hmat3->Sigma_P.push_back(
29147 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29148 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[3],
29149 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[3]));
29150
29155 Sigma_P.pop_back();
29156 }
29157 else if (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
29158 HorizontalSplitMode &&
29159 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == VerticalSplitMode)
29160 {
29161 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
29162 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0], ExcInternalError());
29163 child_hmat0->Sigma_P.push_back(
29164 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29165 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
29166 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
29167
29168 Assert(hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
29169 child_hmat1->Sigma_P.push_back(
29170 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29171 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[0],
29172 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
29173
29174 Assert(hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1], ExcInternalError());
29175 child_hmat2->Sigma_P.push_back(
29176 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29177 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
29178 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[0]));
29179
29180 child_hmat3->Sigma_P.push_back(
29181 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>(
29182 hmat_pair.first->submatrices[1],
29183 hmat_pair.second->submatrices[1]));
29184
29189 Sigma_P.pop_back();
29190 }
29191 else
29192 {
29193 Assert(false, ExcInternalError());
29194 }
29195 }
29196
29201 type = HierarchicalMatrixType;
29202}

29205template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29206void
29207HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::mmult(
29208 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &C,
29209 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &B,
29210 const BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct_a,
29211 const BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct_b,
29212 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct_c,
29213 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
29214{
29225 C.release();
29226
29231 C.Tind = BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type>(
29232 bct_a.get_root()->get_data_reference().get_tau_node(),
29233 bct_b.get_root()->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node(),
29234 bct_c.get_n_min());
29235
29239 std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
29240 initial_hmat_pair(this, &B);
29241 InitHMatrixWrtBlockClusterNode(C, C.Tind.get_root(), initial_hmat_pair);
29246 h_h_mmult_phase1_recursion(&C, C.Tind);
29247
29253 C.Tind.build_leaf_set();
29254 C.Tind.categorize_near_and_far_field_sets();
29255 C.Tind.calc_depth_and_max_level();
29256
29257 // /**
29258 // * DEBUG: Print the structure of the \f$T_{\rm ind}\f$ block cluster
29259 // tree.
29260 // */
29261 // std::ofstream out1("Tind_after_phase1.dat");
29262 // C.Tind.write_leaf_set(out1);
29263 // out1.close();
29264
29268 C.build_leaf_set();
29269
29270 // // DEBUG
29271 // std::cout << "=== Product matrix info before phase 2 ===" <<
29272 // std::endl; C.print_matrix_info(std::cout);
29273
29274 h_h_mmult_phase2(C, bct_c, fixed_rank);
29275
29276 // // DEBUG
29277 // std::cout << "=== Product matrix info after phase 2 ===" <<
29278 // std::endl; C.print_matrix_info(std::cout);
29279
29280 // /**
29281 // * DEBUG: Print the structure of the \f$T_{\rm ind}\f$ block cluster
29282 // tree.
29283 // */
29284 // std::ofstream out2("Tind_after_phase2.dat");
29285 // C.Tind.write_leaf_set(out2);
29286 // out2.close();
29287
29293}

29296template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29297void
29298HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::mmult(
29299 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &C,
29300 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &B,
29301 const BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct_a,
29302 const BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct_b,
29303 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct_c,
29304 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
29305 const bool adding)
29306{
29307 if (adding)
29308 {
29309 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> C_prime;
29310 mmult(C_prime, B, bct_a, bct_b, bct_c, fixed_rank);
29311 C.add(C_prime, fixed_rank);
29312 }
29313 else
29314 {
29315 mmult(C, B, bct_a, bct_b, bct_c, fixed_rank);
29316 }
29317}

29429template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29430void
29431HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::add(HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &C,
29432 const HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &B,
29433 const size_type fixed_rank_k) const
29434{
29439 switch (type)
29440 {
29441 case HierarchicalMatrixType: {
29445 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29446 {
29447 submatrices[i]->add(*(C.submatrices[i]),
29448 *(B.submatrices[i]),
29449 fixed_rank_k);
29450 }
29451
29452 break;
29453 }
29454 case FullMatrixType: {
29458 this->fullmatrix->add(*(C.fullmatrix), *(B.fullmatrix));
29459
29460 break;
29461 }
29462 case RkMatrixType: {
29466 this->rkmatrix->add(*(C.rkmatrix), *(B.rkmatrix), fixed_rank_k);
29467
29468 break;
29469 }
29470 case UndefinedMatrixType:
29471 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
29472 break;
29473 }
29474}

29479HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::add(HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &C,
29480 const Number b,
29481 const HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &B,
29482 const size_type fixed_rank_k) const
29483{
29488 switch (type)
29489 {
29490 case HierarchicalMatrixType: {
29494 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29495 {
29496 submatrices[i]->add(*(C.submatrices[i]),
29497 b,
29498 *(B.submatrices[i]),
29499 fixed_rank_k);
29500 }
29501
29502 break;
29503 }
29504 case FullMatrixType: {
29508 this->fullmatrix->add(*(C.fullmatrix), b, *(B.fullmatrix));
29509
29510 break;
29511 }
29512 case RkMatrixType: {
29516 this->rkmatrix->add(*(C.rkmatrix), b, *(B.rkmatrix), fixed_rank_k);
29517
29518 break;
29519 }
29520 case UndefinedMatrixType:
29521 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
29522 break;
29523 }
29524}

29573
29574template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29575void
29576HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::add(
29577 const RkMatrix<Number> &B,
29578 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &B_row_index_range,
29579 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &B_col_index_range,
29580 const size_type fixed_rank_k,
29581 const bool is_result_matrix_store_tril_only) const
29582{
29583 if (is_result_matrix_store_tril_only)
29584 {
29590 Assert(this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
29591 this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric ||
29592 this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular,
29593 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(this->property));
29594 Assert(this->block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
29595 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(this->block_type));
29596 }
29597
29598 switch (type)
29599 {
29600 case HierarchicalMatrixType: {
29612 if (is_result_matrix_store_tril_only)
29613 {
29614 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29615 {
29616 if (submatrices[i]->block_type !=
29617 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
29618 {
29619 submatrices[i]->add(
29620 B,
29621 B_row_index_range,
29622 B_col_index_range,
29623 fixed_rank_k,
29624 submatrices[i]->property ==
29625 HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
29626 submatrices[i]->property ==
29627 HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric ||
29628 submatrices[i]->property ==
29629 HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular);
29630 }
29631 }
29632 }
29633 else
29634 {
29635 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29636 {
29637 submatrices[i]->add(B,
29638 B_row_index_range,
29639 B_col_index_range,
29640 fixed_rank_k,
29641 false);
29642 }
29643 }
29644
29645 break;
29646 }
29647 case FullMatrixType: {
29659 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> fullmatrix_from_rk;
29660 B.restrictToFullMatrix(B_row_index_range,
29661 B_col_index_range,
29662 fullmatrix_from_rk,
29663 *(row_index_range),
29664 *(col_index_range));
29665
29672 fullmatrix->add((const LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> &)
29673 fullmatrix_from_rk,
29674 is_result_matrix_store_tril_only);
29675
29676 break;
29677 }
29678 case RkMatrixType: {
29689 Assert(!is_result_matrix_store_tril_only, ExcInternalError());
29690
29695 RkMatrix<Number> rkmatrix_by_restriction(*(row_index_range),
29696 *(col_index_range),
29697 B,
29698 B_row_index_range,
29699 B_col_index_range);
29700
29701 this->rkmatrix->add(rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k);
29702
29703 break;
29704 }
29705 case UndefinedMatrixType:
29706 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
29707 break;
29708 }
29709}
29710
29711
29712template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29713void
29714HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::add_for_parallel_lu_or_cholesky(
29715 const RkMatrix<Number> &B,
29716 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &B_row_index_range,
29717 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &B_col_index_range,
29718 const size_type fixed_rank_k,
29719 const bool is_result_matrix_store_tril_only)
29720{
29721 if (is_result_matrix_store_tril_only)
29722 {
29727 Assert(this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
29728 this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular,
29729 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(this->property));
29730 Assert(this->block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
29731 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(this->block_type));
29732 }
29733
29734 switch (type)
29735 {
29736 case HierarchicalMatrixType: {
29748 if (is_result_matrix_store_tril_only)
29749 {
29750 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29751 {
29752 if (submatrices[i]->block_type !=
29753 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
29754 {
29761 submatrices[i]->add_for_parallel_lu_or_cholesky(
29762 B,
29763 B_row_index_range,
29764 B_col_index_range,
29765 fixed_rank_k,
29766 submatrices[i]->property ==
29767 HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
29768 submatrices[i]->property ==
29769 HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular);
29770 }
29771 }
29772 }
29773 else
29774 {
29775 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29776 {
29783 submatrices[i]->add_for_parallel_lu_or_cholesky(
29784 B,
29785 B_row_index_range,
29786 B_col_index_range,
29787 fixed_rank_k,
29788 false);
29789 }
29790 }
29791
29792 break;
29793 }
29794 case FullMatrixType: {
29806 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> fullmatrix_from_rk;
29807 B.restrictToFullMatrix(B_row_index_range,
29808 B_col_index_range,
29809 fullmatrix_from_rk,
29810 *(row_index_range),
29811 *(col_index_range));
29812
29813 {
29818 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(update_lock);
29825 fullmatrix->add((const LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> &)
29826 fullmatrix_from_rk,
29827 is_result_matrix_store_tril_only);
29828 }
29829
29830 break;
29831 }
29832 case RkMatrixType: {
29843 Assert(!is_result_matrix_store_tril_only, ExcInternalError());
29844
29849 RkMatrix<Number> rkmatrix_by_restriction(*(row_index_range),
29850 *(col_index_range),
29851 B,
29852 B_row_index_range,
29853 B_col_index_range);
29854
29855 {
29860 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(update_lock);
29861
29862#if ARENA_OR_ISOLATE_IN_LU_AND_CHOL == 3
29863 this->rkmatrix->add(rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k);
29864#endif
29865
29866
29867#if ARENA_OR_ISOLATE_IN_LU_AND_CHOL == 1
29868 tbb::task_arena ta{ARENA_MAX_CONCURRENCY_IN_LU_AND_CHOL};
29869 ta.execute([this, &rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k] {
29870 this->rkmatrix->add(rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k);
29871 });
29872#endif
29873
29874#if ARENA_OR_ISOLATE_IN_LU_AND_CHOL == 2
29879 tbb::this_task_arena::isolate(
29880 [this, &rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k] {
29881 this->rkmatrix->add(rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k);
29882 });
29883#endif
29884 }
29885
29886 break;
29887 }
29888 case UndefinedMatrixType:
29889 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
29890 break;
29891 }
29892}

29894
29895template <int spacedim, typename Number>
29896void
29897HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::add(
29898 const Number b,
29899 const RkMatrix<Number> &B,
29900 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &B_row_index_range,
29901 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &B_col_index_range,
29902 const size_type fixed_rank_k,
29903 const bool is_result_matrix_store_tril_only) const
29904{

29906 {
29911 Assert(this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
29912 this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric ||
29913 this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular,
29914 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(this->property));
29915 Assert(this->block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
29916 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(this->block_type));
29917 }
29918
29919 switch (type)
29920 {
29921 case HierarchicalMatrixType: {
29928 if (is_result_matrix_store_tril_only)
29929 {
29930 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29931 {
29932 if (submatrices[i]->block_type !=
29933 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
29934 {
29935 submatrices[i]->add(
29936 b,
29937 B,
29938 B_row_index_range,
29939 B_col_index_range,
29940 fixed_rank_k,
29941 submatrices[i]->property ==
29942 HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
29943 submatrices[i]->property ==
29944 HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric ||
29945 submatrices[i]->property ==
29946 HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular);
29947 }
29948 }
29949 }
29950 else
29951 {
29952 for (size_type i = 0; i < submatrices.size(); i++)
29953 {
29954 submatrices[i]->add(b,
29955 B,
29956 B_row_index_range,
29957 B_col_index_range,
29958 fixed_rank_k,
29959 false);
29960 }
29961 }
29962
29963 break;
29964 }
29965 case FullMatrixType: {
29977 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> fullmatrix_from_rk;
29978 B.restrictToFullMatrix(B_row_index_range,
29979 B_col_index_range,
29980 fullmatrix_from_rk,
29981 *(row_index_range),
29982 *(col_index_range));
29983
29984 this->fullmatrix->add(b,
29985 (const LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> &)
29986 fullmatrix_from_rk,
29987 is_result_matrix_store_tril_only);
29988
29989 break;
29990 }
29991 case RkMatrixType: {
30005 RkMatrix<Number> rkmatrix_by_restriction(*(row_index_range),
30006 *(col_index_range),
30007 B,
30008 B_row_index_range,
30009 B_col_index_range);
30010
30011 this->rkmatrix->add(b, rkmatrix_by_restriction, fixed_rank_k);
30012
30013 break;
30014 }
30015 case UndefinedMatrixType:
30016 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
30017 break;
30018 }
30019}

30076template <int spacedim, typename Number>
30077void
30078HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::addsym_diag(const LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> &E)
30079{
30080 if (E.m() != 0 && E.n() != 0)
30081 {
30091 Assert(block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
30092 ExcMessage(
30093 "The current H-matrix node should be a diagonal block!"));
30094
30095 if (type == FullMatrixType)
30096 {
30102 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> EEH;
30103 E.mTmult(EEH, E);
30104
30105 this->fullmatrix->add(EEH);
30106 }
30107 else
30108 {
30113 Assert(type == HierarchicalMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
30114
30115 std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &t1_index_range =
30116 *(submatrices[0]->row_index_range);
30117 std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &t2_index_range =
30118 *(submatrices[3]->row_index_range);
30119
30120 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> E1(t1_index_range[1] - t1_index_range[0],
30121 E.n());
30122 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<Number> E2(t2_index_range[1] - t2_index_range[0],
30123 E.n());
30124
30129 for (size_type i = 0; i < E1.m(); i++)
30130 {
30131 E1.fill_row(i,
30132 t1_index_range[0] - (*this->row_index_range)[0] + i,
30133 E,
30134 std::sqrt(2.0));
30135 }
30136
30141 for (size_type i = 0; i < E2.m(); i++)
30142 {
30143 E2.fill_row(i,
30144 t2_index_range[0] - (*this->row_index_range)[0] + i,
30145 E,
30146 std::sqrt(2.0));
30147 }
30148
30149 submatrices[0]->addsym_diag(E1);
30150 submatrices[3]->addsym_diag(E2);
30151 }
30152 }
30153}

30198template <int spacedim, typename Number>
30199void
30200HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_by_forward_substitution(
30201 Vector<Number> &b,
30202 const bool is_unit_diagonal) const
30203{
30207 AssertDimension(m, n);
30208
30209 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
30210 {
30215 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
30216 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
30217
30218 Vector<Number> local_b(n);
30219
30223 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
30224 {
30225 local_b(j) = b((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
30226 }
30227
30234 fullmatrix->solve_by_forward_substitution(
30235 local_b,
30236 false, // Is transposed
30237 is_unit_diagonal,
30238 true // Is the RHS vector permuted, which should be true when the
30239 // matrix has been applied LU factorization.
30240 );
30241
30245 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
30246 {
30247 b((*row_index_range)[0] + i) = local_b(i);
30248 }
30249 }
30250 else
30251 {
30252 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
30253 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
30254
30255 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
30256
30260 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
30261 {
30266 for (size_type j = 0; j < i; j++)
30267 {
30268 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]->vmult(
30269 b, real_type(-1.0), b, HMatrixSupport::Property::general);
30270 }
30271
30276 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]->solve_by_forward_substitution(
30277 b, is_unit_diagonal);
30278 }
30279 }
30280}

30401template <int spacedim, typename Number>
30402void
30403HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
30404 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &X,
30405 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &Z,
30406 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
30407 const bool is_unit_diagonal) const
30408{
30409 AssertDimension(Z.m, X.m);
30410 AssertDimension(Z.n, X.n);
30411 Assert(
30412 Z.type == X.type,
30413 ExcMessage(
30414 "Matrix Z and X should be built on a same block cluster and thus they should have a same H-matrix type!"));
30415 AssertDimension(this->m, this->n);
30416 AssertDimension(this->n, X.m);
30417
30418 if (Z.type == FullMatrixType)
30419 {
30424 Vector<Number> X_col(X.m);
30425 Vector<Number> Z_col(Z.m);
30426
30430 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.n; j++)
30431 {
30432 Z.fullmatrix->get_column(j, Z_col);
30433
30439 this->solve_by_forward_substitution(X_col,
30440 Z_col,
30441 (*this),
30442 is_unit_diagonal);
30443
30448 X.fullmatrix->fill_col(j, X_col);
30449 }
30450 }
30451 else if (Z.type == RkMatrixType)
30452 {
30470 (*X.rkmatrix) = (*Z.rkmatrix);
30471
30472 Vector<Number> A_prime_col(X.m);
30473 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.rkmatrix->get_formal_rank(); j++)
30474 {
30475 Z.rkmatrix->get_A().get_column(j, A_prime_col);
30476
30477 this->solve_by_forward_substitution(A_prime_col,
30478 (*this),
30479 is_unit_diagonal);
30480
30484 X.rkmatrix->get_A().fill_col(j, A_prime_col);
30485 }
30486 }
30487 else
30488 {
30499 AssertDimension(
30500 this->get_n_row_blocks(),
30501 this->bc_node->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node()->get_child_num());
30502
30508 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = X.get_n_row_blocks();
30509 AssertDimension(this->get_n_row_blocks(), n_row_blocks);
30514 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = X.get_n_col_blocks();
30515
30520 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, Z.get_n_row_blocks());
30521 AssertDimension(n_col_blocks, Z.get_n_col_blocks());
30522
30526 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
30527 {
30534 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
30535 {
30540 for (size_type k = 0; k < i; k++)
30541 {
30542 this->submatrices[i * n_row_blocks + k]
30543 ->mmult_level_conserving(
30544 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
30545 -1.0,
30546 *(X.submatrices[k * n_col_blocks + j]),
30547 fixed_rank);
30548 }
30549
30554 this->submatrices[i * n_row_blocks + i]
30555 ->solve_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
30556 *(X.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
30557 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
30558 fixed_rank,
30559 is_unit_diagonal);
30560 }
30561 }
30562 }
30563}
30564
30565
30566template <int spacedim, typename Number>
30567void
30568HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
30569 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &Z,
30570 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
30571 const bool is_unit_diagonal) const
30572{
30573 AssertDimension(this->m, this->n);
30574 AssertDimension(this->n, Z.m);
30575
30576 if (Z.type == FullMatrixType)
30577 {
30582 Vector<Number> Z_col(Z.m);
30583
30587 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.n; j++)
30588 {
30589 Z.fullmatrix->get_column(j, Z_col);
30590
30596 this->solve_by_forward_substitution(Z_col, (*this), is_unit_diagonal);
30597
30601 Z.fullmatrix->fill_col(j, Z_col);
30602 }
30603 }
30604 else if (Z.type == RkMatrixType)
30605 {
30623 Vector<Number> A_prime_col(Z.m);
30624 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.rkmatrix->get_formal_rank(); j++)
30625 {
30626 Z.rkmatrix->get_A().get_column(j, A_prime_col);
30627
30628 this->solve_by_forward_substitution(A_prime_col,
30629 (*this),
30630 is_unit_diagonal);
30631
30635 Z.rkmatrix->get_A().fill_col(j, A_prime_col);
30636 }
30637 }
30638 else
30639 {
30650 AssertDimension(
30651 this->get_n_row_blocks(),
30652 this->bc_node->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node()->get_child_num());
30653
30659 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = Z.get_n_row_blocks();
30660 AssertDimension(this->get_n_row_blocks(), n_row_blocks);
30665 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = Z.get_n_col_blocks();
30666
30670 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
30671 {
30678 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
30679 {
30684 for (size_type k = 0; k < i; k++)
30685 {
30686 this->submatrices[i * n_row_blocks + k]
30687 ->mmult_level_conserving(
30688 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
30689 -1.0,
30690 *(Z.submatrices[k * n_col_blocks + j]),
30691 fixed_rank);
30692 }
30693
30698 this->submatrices[i * n_row_blocks + i]
30699 ->solve_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
30700 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
30701 fixed_rank,
30702 is_unit_diagonal);
30703 }
30704 }
30705 }
30706}

30732HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution(

30734{

30740 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
30741 {
30747 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
30748 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
30749
30750 Vector<Number> local_b(m);
30751
30755 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
30756 {
30757 local_b(i) = b((*row_index_range)[0] + i);
30758 }
30759
30764 fullmatrix->solve_by_forward_substitution(local_b, true, false, false);
30765
30769 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
30770 {
30771 b((*col_index_range)[0] + j) = local_b(j);
30772 }
30773 }
30774 else
30775 {
30776 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
30777
30778 AssertDimension(get_n_row_blocks(), n_col_blocks);
30779
30784 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
30785 {
30790 for (size_type i = 0; i < j; i++)
30791 {
30792 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]->Tvmult(
30793 b, real_type(-1.0), b, HMatrixSupport::Property::general);
30794 }
30795
30800 submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
30801 ->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution(b);
30802 }
30803 }

30913
30914template <int spacedim, typename Number>
30915void
30916HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::
30917 solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
30918 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &X,
30919 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &Z,
30920 const unsigned int fixed_rank) const
30921{
30922 AssertDimension(Z.m, X.m);
30923 AssertDimension(Z.n, X.n);
30924 Assert(
30925 Z.type == X.type,
30926 ExcMessage(
30927 "Matrix Z and X should be built on a same block cluster and thus have a same H-matrix type!"));
30928 AssertDimension(this->m, this->n);
30929 AssertDimension(X.n, this->m);
30930
30931 if (Z.type == FullMatrixType)
30932 {
30937 Vector<Number> X_row(X.n);
30938 Vector<Number> Z_row(Z.n);
30939
30943 for (size_type i = 0; i < Z.m; i++)
30944 {
30945 Z.fullmatrix->get_row(i, Z_row);
30946
30953 this->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution(X_row, Z_row, (*this));
30954
30959 X.fullmatrix->fill_row(i, X_row);
30960 }
30961 }
30962 else if (Z.type == RkMatrixType)
30963 {
30964 (*X.rkmatrix) = (*Z.rkmatrix);
30965
30966 // Let \f$Z\vert_{\tau\times\sigma} = A\cdot B^T\f$ and
30967 // \f$X\vert_{\tau\times\sigma}=A\cdot B'^T\f$, solve the problem \f$U^T
30968 // B' = B\f$.
30969 Vector<Number> B_prime_col(X.n);
30970 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.rkmatrix->get_formal_rank(); j++)
30971 {
30972 // Get the current RHS vector directly into the solution vector.
30973 Z.rkmatrix->get_B().get_column(j, B_prime_col);
30974
30979 this->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution(B_prime_col, (*this));
30980
30986 X.rkmatrix->get_B().fill_col(j, B_prime_col);
30987 }
30988 }
30989 else
30990 {
31002 AssertDimension(
31003 this->get_n_row_blocks(),
31004 this->bc_node->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node()->get_child_num());
31005
31010 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = X.get_n_row_blocks();
31017 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = X.get_n_col_blocks();
31018 AssertDimension(this->get_n_row_blocks(), n_col_blocks);
31019
31026 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, Z.get_n_row_blocks());
31027 AssertDimension(n_col_blocks, Z.get_n_col_blocks());
31028
31033 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
31034 {
31041 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
31042 {
31049 for (size_type k = 0; k < j; k++)
31050 {
31051 X.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mmult_level_conserving(
31052 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31053 -1.0,
31054 *(this->submatrices[k * n_col_blocks + j]),
31055 fixed_rank);
31056 }
31057
31062 this->submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
31063 ->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
31064 *(X.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31065 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31066 fixed_rank);
31067 }
31068 }
31069 }
31070}
31071
31072
31073template <int spacedim, typename Number>
31074void
31075HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::
31076 solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
31077 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &Z,
31078 const unsigned int fixed_rank) const
31079{
31080 AssertDimension(this->m, this->n);
31081 AssertDimension(Z.n, this->m);
31082
31083 if (Z.type == FullMatrixType)
31084 {
31089 Vector<Number> Z_row(Z.n);
31090
31094 for (size_type i = 0; i < Z.m; i++)
31095 {
31096 Z.fullmatrix->get_row(i, Z_row);
31097
31104 this->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution(Z_row, (*this));
31105
31109 Z.fullmatrix->fill_row(i, Z_row);
31110 }
31111 }
31112 else if (Z.type == RkMatrixType)
31113 {
31114 // Let \f$Z\vert_{\tau\times\sigma} = A\cdot B^T\f$ and
31115 // \f$X\vert_{\tau\times\sigma}=A\cdot B'^T\f$, solve the problem \f$U^T
31116 // B' = B\f$.
31117 Vector<Number> B_col(Z.n);
31118 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.rkmatrix->get_formal_rank(); j++)
31119 {
31120 // Get the current RHS vector directly into the solution vector.
31121 Z.rkmatrix->get_B().get_column(j, B_col);
31122
31127 this->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution(B_col, (*this));
31128
31132 Z.rkmatrix->get_B().fill_col(j, B_col);
31133 }
31134 }
31135 else
31136 {
31148 AssertDimension(
31149 this->get_n_row_blocks(),
31150 this->bc_node->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node()->get_child_num());
31151
31155 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = Z.get_n_row_blocks();
31161 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = Z.get_n_col_blocks();
31162 AssertDimension(this->get_n_row_blocks(), n_col_blocks);
31163
31168 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
31169 {
31176 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
31177 {
31184 for (size_type k = 0; k < j; k++)
31185 {
31186 Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mmult_level_conserving(
31187 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31188 -1.0,
31189 *(this->submatrices[k * n_col_blocks + j]),
31190 fixed_rank);
31191 }
31192
31197 this->submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
31198 ->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
31199 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), fixed_rank);
31200 }
31201 }
31202 }
31203}
31204
31205
31206template <int spacedim, typename Number>
31207void
31208HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::
31209 solve_cholesky_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
31210 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &X,
31211 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &Z,
31212 const unsigned int fixed_rank) const
31213{
31214 AssertDimension(Z.m, X.m);
31215 AssertDimension(Z.n, X.n);
31216 Assert(
31217 Z.type == X.type,
31218 ExcMessage(
31219 "Matrix Z and X should be built on a same block cluster and thus have a same H-matrix type!"));
31220 AssertDimension(this->m, this->n);
31228 AssertDimension(X.n, this->n);
31229
31230 if (Z.type == FullMatrixType)
31231 {
31236 Vector<Number> X_row(X.n);
31237 Vector<Number> Z_row(Z.n);
31238
31242 for (size_type i = 0; i < Z.m; i++)
31243 {
31244 Z.fullmatrix->get_row(i, Z_row);
31245
31253 this->solve_by_forward_substitution(X_row, Z_row, (*this), false);
31254
31259 X.fullmatrix->fill_row(i, X_row);
31260 }
31261 }
31262 else if (Z.type == RkMatrixType)
31263 {
31264 (*X.rkmatrix) = (*Z.rkmatrix);
31265
31266 Vector<Number> B_prime_col(X.n);
31267 for (size_type j = 0; j < Z.rkmatrix->get_formal_rank(); j++)
31268 {
31269 Z.rkmatrix->get_B().get_column(j, B_prime_col);
31270
31276 this->solve_by_forward_substitution(B_prime_col, (*this), false);
31277
31281 X.rkmatrix->get_B().fill_col(j, B_prime_col);
31282 }
31283 }
31284 else
31285 {
31296 AssertDimension(
31297 this->get_n_row_blocks(),
31298 this->bc_node->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node()->get_child_num());
31299
31304 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = X.get_n_row_blocks();
31311 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = X.get_n_col_blocks();
31312 AssertDimension(this->get_n_col_blocks(), n_col_blocks);
31313
31318 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, Z.get_n_row_blocks());
31319 AssertDimension(n_col_blocks, Z.get_n_col_blocks());
31320
31326 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
31327 {
31334 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
31335 {
31347 for (size_type k = 0; k < j; k++)
31348 {
31349 X.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mTmult_level_conserving(
31350 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31351 -1.0,
31352 *(this->submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + k]),
31353 fixed_rank);
31354 }
31355
31361 this->submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
31362 ->solve_cholesky_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
31363 *(X.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31364 *(Z.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
31365 fixed_rank);
31366 }
31367 }
31368 }
31369}

31514template <int spacedim, typename Number>
31515void
31516HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_block_triangular_by_forward_substitution(
31517 Vector<Number> &b,
31518 const bool is_unit_block_diagonal) const
31519{
31523 AssertDimension(m, n);
31524
31525 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
31526 {
31531 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
31532 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
31533
31534 if (is_unit_block_diagonal)
31535 {
31541 }
31542 else
31543 {
31549 Vector<Number> local_b(n);
31550
31555 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
31556 {
31557 local_b(j) = b((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
31558 }
31559
31563 fullmatrix->compute_lu_factorization();
31564 fullmatrix->solve(local_b);
31565
31570 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
31571 {
31572 b((*row_index_range)[0] + i) = local_b(i);
31573 }
31574 }
31575 }
31576 else
31577 {
31581 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
31582 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
31583
31584 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
31585
31586 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
31587 {
31592 for (size_type j = 0; j < i; j++)
31593 {
31594 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]->vmult(
31595 b, real_type(-1.0), b, HMatrixSupport::Property::general);
31596 }
31597
31602 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]
31603 ->solve_block_triangular_by_forward_substitution(
31604 b, is_unit_block_diagonal);
31605 }
31606 }
31607}

31788template <int spacedim, typename Number>
31789void
31790HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_by_backward_substitution(
31791 Vector<Number> &b,
31792 const bool is_unit_diagonal) const
31793{
31797 AssertDimension(m, n);
31798
31799 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
31800 {
31805 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
31806 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
31807
31808 Vector<Number> local_b(n);
31809
31813 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
31814 {
31815 local_b(j) = b((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
31816 }
31817
31821 fullmatrix->solve_by_backward_substitution(local_b,
31822 false, // Is transposed
31823 is_unit_diagonal);
31824
31828 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
31829 {
31830 b((*row_index_range)[0] + i) = local_b(i);
31831 }
31832 }
31833 else
31834 {
31838 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
31839 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
31840
31841 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
31842
31849 for (int i = n_row_blocks - 1; i >= 0; i--)
31850 {
31855 for (size_type j = i + 1; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
31856 {
31857 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]->vmult(
31858 b, real_type(-1.0), b, HMatrixSupport::Property::general);
31859 }
31860
31865 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]->solve_by_backward_substitution(
31866 b, is_unit_diagonal);
31867 }
31868 }
31869}

32122 {
32128 }
32129 else
32130 {
32136 Vector<Number> local_b(n);
32137
32142 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
32143 {
32144 local_b(j) = b((*col_index_range)[0] -
32145 (*starting_hmat.col_index_range)[0] + j);
32146 }
32147
32151 fullmatrix->compute_lu_factorization();
32152 fullmatrix->solve(local_b);
32153
32158 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
32159 {
32160 b((*row_index_range)[0] - (*starting_hmat.row_index_range)[0] +
32161 i) = local_b(i);
32162 }
32163 }
32164 }
32165 else
32166 {
32170 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
32171 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
32172
32173 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
32174
32181 for (int i = n_row_blocks - 1; i >= 0; i--)
32182 {
32187 for (size_type j = i + 1; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
32188 {
32189 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]->vmult(
32190 b,
32191 real_type(-1.0),
32192 b,
32193 starting_hmat,
32194 HMatrixSupport::Property::general);
32195 }
32196
32200 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]
32201 ->solve_block_triangular_by_backward_substitution(
32202 b, starting_hmat, is_unit_block_diagonal);
32203 }
32204 }
32205}
32206
32207
32208template <int spacedim, typename Number>
32209void
32210HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_block_triangular_by_backward_substitution(
32211 Vector<Number> &x,
32212 const Vector<Number> &b,
32213 const HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &starting_hmat,
32214 const bool is_unit_block_diagonal) const
32215{
32216 x = b;
32217 solve_block_triangular_by_backward_substitution(x,
32218 starting_hmat,
32219 is_unit_block_diagonal);
32220}

32222
32223template <int spacedim, typename Number>
32224void
32225HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_cholesky_by_backward_substitution(
32226 Vector<Number> &b) const
32227{
32228 Assert(state == HMatrixSupport::cholesky, ExcInvalidHMatrixState(state));
32229
32233 AssertDimension(m, n);
32234
32235 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
32236 {
32241 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
32242 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
32243
32244 Vector<Number> local_b(m);
32245
32251 for (size_type i = 0; i < m; i++)
32252 {
32253 local_b(i) = b((*row_index_range)[0] + i);
32254 }
32255
32262 fullmatrix->solve_by_backward_substitution(local_b,
32263 true, // Is transposed
32264 false // Is unit diagonal
32265 );
32266
32270 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
32271 {
32272 b((*col_index_range)[0] + j) = local_b(j);
32273 }
32274 }
32275 else
32276 {
32277 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
32278 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
32279
32280 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
32281
32285 for (int j = n_col_blocks - 1; j >= 0; j--)
32286 {
32291 for (size_type i = j + 1; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
32292 {
32297 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]->Tvmult(
32298 b, real_type(-1.0), b, HMatrixSupport::Property::general);
32299 }
32300
32305 submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
32306 ->solve_cholesky_by_backward_substitution(b);
32307 }
32308 }
32309}

32314HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_cholesky_by_backward_substitution(

32328{

32343 Vector<Number> local_b(m);

32351 {
32352 local_b(i) =
32353 b((*row_index_range)[0] - (*starting_hmat.row_index_range)[0] + i);
32354 }
32355
32360 fullmatrix->solve_by_backward_substitution(local_b,

32362 false // Is unit diagonal

32364
32368 for (size_type j = 0; j < n; j++)
32369 {
32370 b((*col_index_range)[0] - (*starting_hmat.col_index_range)[0] + j) =

32380
32384 for (int j = n_col_blocks - 1; j >= 0; j--)

32457
32458template <int spacedim, typename Number>
32459void
32460HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::_compute_lu_factorization(
32461 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &LU,
32462 const unsigned int fixed_rank) const
32463{
32464 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
32465 {
32474 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
32475 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
32476 Assert(LU.fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
32477
32481 *(LU.fullmatrix) = *fullmatrix;
32482
32487 LU.fullmatrix->compute_lu_factorization();
32488 }
32489 else
32490 {
32491 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
32492 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
32493
32498 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
32499
32504 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
32505 {
32509 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
32510 {
32518 const size_type min_ij = std::min(i, j);
32523 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> Z(*(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]));
32524 for (size_type k = 0; k < min_ij; k++)
32525 {
32526 LU.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mmult_level_conserving(
32527 Z,
32528 -1.0,
32529 *(LU.submatrices[k * n_col_blocks + j]),
32530 fixed_rank);
32531 }
32532
32533 if (j < i)
32534 {
32541 LU.submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
32542 ->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
32543 *(LU.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), Z, fixed_rank);
32544 }
32545 else if (j == i)
32546 {
32551 Z._compute_lu_factorization(
32552 *(LU.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]), fixed_rank);
32553 }
32554 else if (j > i)
32555 {
32559 LU.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]
32560 ->solve_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
32561 *(LU.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), Z, fixed_rank);
32562 }
32563 }
32564 }
32565 }
32566}
32567
32568
32569template <int spacedim, typename Number>
32570void
32571HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::_compute_lu_factorization(
32572 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
32573{
32574 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
32575 {
32584 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
32585 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
32586
32591 fullmatrix->compute_lu_factorization();
32592 }
32593 else
32594 {
32595 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
32596 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
32597
32602 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
32603
32608 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
32609 {
32613 for (size_type j = 0; j < n_col_blocks; j++)
32614 {
32622 const size_type min_ij = std::min(i, j);
32623
32624 for (size_type k = 0; k < min_ij; k++)
32625 {
32626 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mmult_level_conserving(
32627 *(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
32628 -1.0,
32629 *(submatrices[k * n_col_blocks + j]),
32630 fixed_rank);
32631 }
32632
32633 if (j < i)
32634 {
32641 submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
32642 ->solve_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
32643 *(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), fixed_rank);
32644 }
32645 else if (j == i)
32646 {
32651 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]->_compute_lu_factorization(
32652 fixed_rank);
32653 }
32654 else if (j > i)
32655 {
32659 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]
32660 ->solve_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
32661 *(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), fixed_rank);
32662 }
32663 }
32664 }
32665 }
32666}

32668
32669template <int spacedim, typename Number>
32670void
32671HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_lu_factorization_task_parallel(
32672 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
32673{
32674 // Set OpenBLAS num threads to 1 when task parallelization is used.
32675 const int blas_num_threads = openblas_get_num_threads();
32676 openblas_set_num_threads(1);
32677
32678#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32679 Timer timer;
32680#endif
32684 this->link_hmat_nodes_on_cross_from_diagonal_blocks(this->property);
32685#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32686 timer.stop();
32687 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "link H-matrix nodes");
32688#endif
32689
32693 std::mutex log_stream_lock;
32694
32698 tbb::flow::graph dag;
32699
32700#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32701 timer.start();
32702#endif
32703 compute_lu_dag(dag, fixed_rank, log_stream_lock);
32704#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32705 timer.stop();
32706 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "compute dag");
32707#endif
32708
32709#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32710 timer.start();
32711#endif
32712 lu_assign_update_to_solve_and_factorize_dependencies();
32713#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32714 timer.stop();
32715 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "contribute update");
32716#endif
32717
32722 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *top_left_node = this->get_top_left_leaf_node();
32723 Assert(top_left_node != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
32724 Assert(top_left_node->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node,
32725 ExcInternalError());
32726
32727#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32728 timer.start();
32729#endif
32730 top_left_node->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node->try_put(
32731 tbb::flow::continue_msg());
32732
32733 dag.wait_for_all();
32734#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
32735 timer.stop();
32736 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "compute lu");
32737#endif
32738 clear_lu_or_cholesky_task_nodes();
32739
32743 this->set_state(HMatrixSupport::lu);
32744
32745 // Restore the original OpenBLAS num threads.
32746 openblas_set_num_threads(blas_num_threads);
32747}
32748
32749
32750template <int spacedim, typename Number>
32751void
32752HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_lu_dag(tbb::flow::graph &dag,
32753 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
32754 std::mutex &log_stream_lock)
32755{
32756 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
32757 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
32758
32763 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
32764
32768 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
32769 {
32770 // <code>i * n_col_blocks + i</code> returns the linear index for the
32771 // diagonal block on the i-th row.
32772 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_diag_block =
32773 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i];
32774 const bool is_diag_block_leaf = current_diag_block->is_leaf();
32775
32776 current_diag_block->compute_lu_dag(dag, fixed_rank, log_stream_lock);
32777 current_diag_block->lu_factorize_diagonal_block_task(dag,
32778 log_stream_lock);
32779
32785 for (HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_diag_column_block =
32786 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
32787 current_diag_column_block != nullptr;
32788 current_diag_column_block =
32789 current_diag_column_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node)
32790 {
32791 if (is_diag_block_leaf || current_diag_column_block->is_leaf())
32792 {
32798 current_diag_block->lu_solve_upper_task(
32799 dag, *current_diag_column_block, fixed_rank, log_stream_lock);
32800
32806#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
32807 std::cout << "factorize-to-solve-upper at level "
32808 << current_diag_block->bc_node->get_level() << ": ["
32809 << (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[0] << ","
32810 << (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
32811 << (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[0] << ","
32812 << (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[1]
32813 << ") --> ["
32814 << (*current_diag_column_block->row_index_range)[0]
32815 << ","
32816 << (*current_diag_column_block->row_index_range)[1]
32817 << "), ["
32818 << (*current_diag_column_block->col_index_range)[0]
32819 << ","
32820 << (*current_diag_column_block->col_index_range)[1]
32821 << ")" << std::endl;
32822#endif
32823 tbb::flow::make_edge(
32824 *(current_diag_block->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node),
32825 *(current_diag_column_block
32826 ->solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node));
32827 }
32828 }
32829
32835 for (HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_diag_row_block =
32836 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node;
32837 current_diag_row_block != nullptr;
32838 current_diag_row_block =
32839 current_diag_row_block->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node)
32840 {
32841 if (is_diag_block_leaf || current_diag_row_block->is_leaf())
32842 {
32848 current_diag_block->lu_solve_lower_task(dag,
32849 *current_diag_row_block,
32850 fixed_rank,
32851 log_stream_lock);
32852
32858#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
32859 std::cout << "factorize-to-solve-lower at level "
32860 << current_diag_block->bc_node->get_level() << ": ["
32861 << (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[0] << ","
32862 << (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
32863 << (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[0] << ","
32864 << (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[1]
32865 << ") --> ["
32866 << (*current_diag_row_block->row_index_range)[0] << ","
32867 << (*current_diag_row_block->row_index_range)[1]
32868 << "), ["
32869 << (*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range)[0] << ","
32870 << (*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range)[1] << ")"
32871 << std::endl;
32872#endif
32873 tbb::flow::make_edge(
32874 *(current_diag_block->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node),
32875 *(current_diag_row_block
32876 ->solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node));
32877 }
32878 }
32879
32886 for (HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *
32887 current_trailing_block =
32888 current_diag_block->next_same_level_hmat_node,
32889 *current_diag_row_block =
32890 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node,
32891 *current_diag_column_block =
32892 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
32893 current_trailing_block != nullptr;
32894 current_trailing_block =
32895 current_trailing_block->next_same_level_hmat_node)
32896 {
32901 if ((*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[0] >=
32902 (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[1] &&
32903 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
32904 (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[1])
32905 {
32906 bool is_diag_row_block_found = false;
32907 bool is_diag_column_block_found = false;
32908
32913 while (current_diag_row_block != nullptr &&
32914 current_diag_row_block != current_diag_block)
32915 {
32916 if (*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range ==
32917 *current_trailing_block->col_index_range)
32918 {
32922 is_diag_row_block_found = true;
32923
32924 break;
32925 }
32926 else if ((*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
32927 (*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range)[1])
32928 {
32932 current_diag_row_block =
32933 current_diag_row_block
32934 ->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node;
32935
32936 if (current_diag_row_block != nullptr &&
32937 (*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
32938 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[1])
32939 {
32946 break;
32947 }
32948 }
32949 else if ((*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
32950 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[1])
32951 {
32955 current_diag_row_block =
32956 current_diag_row_block
32957 ->previous_same_level_same_row_hmat_node;
32958
32959 if (current_diag_row_block != nullptr &&
32960 current_diag_row_block != current_diag_block &&
32961 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
32962 (*current_diag_row_block->col_index_range)[1])
32963 {
32970 break;
32971 }
32972 }
32973 }
32974
32975 if (is_diag_row_block_found)
32976 {
32981 while (current_diag_column_block != nullptr &&
32982 current_diag_column_block != current_diag_block)
32983 {
32984 if (*current_diag_column_block->row_index_range ==
32985 *current_trailing_block->row_index_range)
32986 {
32990 is_diag_column_block_found = true;
32991
32992 break;
32993 }
32994 else if ((*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[0] >=
32995 (*current_diag_column_block->row_index_range)[1])
32996 {
33000 current_diag_column_block =
33001 current_diag_column_block
33002 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
33003
33004 if (current_diag_column_block != nullptr &&
33005 (*current_diag_column_block
33006 ->row_index_range)[0] >=
33007 (*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[1])
33008 {
33016 break;
33017 }
33018 }
33019 else if ((*current_diag_column_block
33020 ->row_index_range)[0] >=
33021 (*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[1])
33022 {
33026 current_diag_column_block =
33027 current_diag_column_block
33028 ->previous_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
33029
33030 if (current_diag_column_block != nullptr &&
33031 current_diag_column_block != current_diag_block &&
33032 (*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[0] >=
33033 (*current_diag_column_block
33034 ->row_index_range)[1])
33035 {
33043 break;
33044 }
33045 }
33046 }
33047
33048 if (!is_diag_column_block_found)
33049 {
33055 if (current_diag_column_block == nullptr ||
33056 current_diag_column_block == current_diag_block)
33057 {
33058 current_diag_column_block =
33059 current_diag_block
33060 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
33061 }
33062 }
33063 }
33064 else
33065 {
33071 if (current_diag_row_block == nullptr ||
33072 current_diag_row_block == current_diag_block)
33073 {
33074 current_diag_row_block =
33075 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node;
33076 }
33077 }
33078
33083 if (is_diag_row_block_found && is_diag_column_block_found)
33084 {
33085 if (current_trailing_block->is_leaf() ||
33086 current_diag_row_block->is_leaf() ||
33087 current_diag_column_block->is_leaf())
33088 {
33093 current_trailing_block->lu_update_task(
33094 dag,
33095 *current_diag_block,
33096 *current_diag_column_block,
33097 *current_diag_row_block,
33098 fixed_rank,
33099 log_stream_lock);
33100
33106 current_diag_row_block
33107 ->lu_build_solve_lower_to_update_dependencies(
33108 *current_trailing_block);
33109
33115 current_diag_column_block
33116 ->lu_or_cholesky_build_solve_upper_to_update_dependencies(
33117 *current_trailing_block);
33118 }
33119 }
33120 }
33121 }
33122 }
33123}
33124
33125
33126template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33127void
33128HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::lu_factorize_diagonal_block_task(
33129 tbb::flow::graph &dag,
33130 std::mutex &log_stream_lock)
33131{
33135 Assert(block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
33136 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
33137
33138 this->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node = std::make_shared<TaskNode>(
33139 dag, [this, &log_stream_lock](const tbb::flow::continue_msg &msg) {
33140#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 3
33141 {
33142 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(log_stream_lock);
33143
33144 std::cout << std::this_thread::get_id() << "#lu_factorize: ["
33145 << (*this->row_index_range)[0] << ","
33146 << (*this->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
33147 << (*this->col_index_range)[0] << ","
33148 << (*this->col_index_range)[1] << ")" << std::endl;
33149 }
33150#endif
33151
33152 if (this->is_leaf())
33153 {
33162 Assert(this->type == FullMatrixType,
33163 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(this->type));
33164 Assert(this->fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
33165
33170 this->fullmatrix->compute_lu_factorization();
33171 }
33172
33173 return msg;
33174 });
