33504
33505template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33506void
33507HMatrix<spacedim,
33508 Number>::lu_assign_update_to_solve_and_factorize_dependencies()
33509{
33510 if (solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node)
33511 {
33516 lu_build_update_to_solve_upper_or_lower_dependencies(*this);
33517
33523 }
33524 else
33525 {
33526 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block)
33527 {
33533 if (factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node)
33534 {
33535 lu_build_update_to_factorize_dependencies(*this);
33536
33543 if (parent != nullptr &&
33544 parent->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node &&
33545 // Only when the current matrix block is the last diagonal
33546 // block within its parent matrix, the
33547 // factorization-to-factorization task dependency will be
33548 // created.
33549 submatrix_index == (parent->get_n_row_blocks() - 1) *
33550 (parent->get_n_col_blocks() + 1))
33551 {
33552#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
33553 std::cout << "factorize-to-factorize at level ("
33554 << this->bc_node->get_level() << ","
33555 << parent->bc_node->get_level() << "): ["
33556 << (*this->row_index_range)[0] << ","
33557 << (*this->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
33558 << (*this->col_index_range)[0] << ","
33559 << (*this->col_index_range)[1] << ") --> ["
33560 << (*parent->row_index_range)[0] << ","
33561 << (*parent->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
33562 << (*parent->col_index_range)[0] << ","
33563 << (*parent->col_index_range)[1] << ")"
33564 << std::endl;
33565#endif
33566
33567 tbb::flow::make_edge(
33568 *factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node,
33569 *parent->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node);
33570 }
33571 }
33572 }
33573
33579 for (auto submatrix : submatrices)
33580 {
33584 if (update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.size() > 0)
33585 {
33586 submatrix->update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.insert(
33587 submatrix->update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.end(),
33588 update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.begin(),
33589 update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.end());
33590 }
33591
33592 submatrix->lu_assign_update_to_solve_and_factorize_dependencies();
33593 }
33594 }
33595}

33597
33598template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33599void
33600HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::_compute_cholesky_factorization(
33601 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &L,
33602 const unsigned int fixed_rank) const
33603{
33604 Assert(this->state == HMatrixSupport::State::matrix,
33605 ExcInvalidHMatrixState(this->state));
33606 Assert(this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric,
33607 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(this->property));
33608 Assert(this->block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
33609 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(this->block_type));
33610
33611 Assert(L.state == HMatrixSupport::State::matrix,
33612 ExcInvalidHMatrixState(L.state));
33613 Assert(L.property == HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular ||
33614 L.property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric,
33615 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(L.property));
33616 Assert(L.block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
33617 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(L.block_type));
33618
33619 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
33620 {
33629 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
33630 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
33631 Assert(L.fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
33632
33643 *(L.fullmatrix) = *fullmatrix;
33644
33645 Assert(L.fullmatrix->get_property() == LAPACKSupport::Property::symmetric,
33646 ExcInvalidLAPACKFullMatrixProperty(L.fullmatrix->get_property()));
33647
33652 L.fullmatrix->compute_cholesky_factorization();
33653 }
33654 else
33655 {
33656 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
33657 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
33658
33663 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
33664
33669 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
33670 {
33675 for (size_type j = 0; j <= i; j++)
33676 {
33681 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> Z(*(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]));
33682
33698 for (size_type k = 0; k < j; k++)
33699 {
33700 L.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mTmult_level_conserving(
33701 Z,
33702 -1.0,
33703 *(L.submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + k]),
33704 fixed_rank,
33705 (i == j));
33706 }
33707
33708 if (j < i)
33709 {
33716 L.submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
33717 ->solve_cholesky_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
33718 *(L.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), Z, fixed_rank);
33719 }
33720 else if (j == i)
33721 {
33726 Z._compute_cholesky_factorization(
33727 *(L.submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]), fixed_rank);
33728 }
33729 else
33730 {
33731 Assert(false, ExcInternalError());
33732 }
33733 }
33734 }
33735 }
33736}
33737
33738
33739template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33740void
33741HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_cholesky_factorization(
33742 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &L,
33743 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
33744{
33745 this->_compute_cholesky_factorization(L, fixed_rank);
33746
33753 L.set_state(HMatrixSupport::cholesky);
33754 this->set_state(HMatrixSupport::unusable);
33755}
33756
33757
33758template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33759void
33760HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::_compute_cholesky_factorization(
33761 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
33762{
33763 Assert(this->state == HMatrixSupport::State::matrix,
33764 ExcInvalidHMatrixState(this->state));
33765 Assert(this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric,
33766 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(this->property));
33767 Assert(this->block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
33768 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(this->block_type));
33769
33770 if (type != HierarchicalMatrixType)
33771 {
33780 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
33781 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
33782
33783 Assert(fullmatrix->get_property() == LAPACKSupport::Property::symmetric,
33784 ExcInvalidLAPACKFullMatrixProperty(fullmatrix->get_property()));
33785
33790 fullmatrix->compute_cholesky_factorization();
33791 }
33792 else
33793 {
33794 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
33795 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
33796
33801 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
33802
33807 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
33808 {
33813 for (size_type j = 0; j <= i; j++)
33814 {
33830 for (size_type k = 0; k < j; k++)
33831 {
33832 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + k]->mTmult_level_conserving(
33833 *(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]),
33834 -1.0,
33835 *(submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + k]),
33836 fixed_rank,
33837 (i == j));
33838 }
33839
33840 if (j < i)
33841 {
33848 submatrices[j * n_col_blocks + j]
33849 ->solve_cholesky_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
33850 *(submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + j]), fixed_rank);
33851 }
33852 else if (j == i)
33853 {
33858 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]
33859 ->_compute_cholesky_factorization(fixed_rank);
33860 }
33861 else
33862 {
33863 Assert(false, ExcInternalError());
33864 }
33865 }
33866 }
33867 }
33868}

33871template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33872void
33873HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_cholesky_factorization(
33874 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
33875{
33876 this->_compute_cholesky_factorization(fixed_rank);
33877

33886
33887template <int spacedim, typename Number>
33888void
33889HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_cholesky_dag(tbb::flow::graph &dag,
33890 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
33891 std::mutex &log_stream_lock)
33892{
33893 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
33894 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
33895
33896 AssertDimension(n_row_blocks, n_col_blocks);
33897
33901 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
33902 {
33903 // <code>i * n_col_blocks + i</code> returns the linear index for the
33904 // diagonal block on the i-th row.
33905 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_diag_block =
33906 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i];
33907 const bool is_diag_block_leaf = current_diag_block->is_leaf();
33908
33909 current_diag_block->compute_cholesky_dag(dag,
33910 fixed_rank,
33911 log_stream_lock);
33912 current_diag_block->cholesky_factorize_diagonal_block_task(
33913 dag, log_stream_lock);
33914
33920 for (HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_diag_column_block =
33921 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
33922 current_diag_column_block != nullptr;
33923 current_diag_column_block =
33924 current_diag_column_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node)
33925 {
33926 if (is_diag_block_leaf || current_diag_column_block->is_leaf())
33927 {
33933 current_diag_block->cholesky_solve_upper_task(
33934 dag, *current_diag_column_block, fixed_rank, log_stream_lock);
33935
33941#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
33942 std::cout << "factorize-to-solve-transpose-upper at level "
33943 << current_diag_block->bc_node->get_level() << ": ["
33944 << (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[0] << ","
33945 << (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
33946 << (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[0] << ","
33947 << (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[1]
33948 << ") --> ["
33949 << (*current_diag_column_block->row_index_range)[0]
33950 << ","
33951 << (*current_diag_column_block->row_index_range)[1]
33952 << "), ["
33953 << (*current_diag_column_block->col_index_range)[0]
33954 << ","
33955 << (*current_diag_column_block->col_index_range)[1]
33956 << ")" << std::endl;
33957#endif
33958 tbb::flow::make_edge(
33959 *(current_diag_block->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node),
33960 *(current_diag_column_block
33961 ->solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node));
33962 }
33963 }
33964
33980 for (HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *
33981 current_trailing_block =
33982 current_diag_block->next_same_level_hmat_node,
33983 *current_diag_column_block1 =
33984 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node,
33985 *current_diag_column_block2 =
33986 current_diag_block->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
33987 current_trailing_block != nullptr;
33988 current_trailing_block =
33989 current_trailing_block->next_same_level_hmat_node)
33990 {
33995 if ((*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[0] >=
33996 (*current_diag_block->row_index_range)[1] &&
33997 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
33998 (*current_diag_block->col_index_range)[1])
33999 {
34000 bool is_diag_column_block1_found = false;
34001 bool is_diag_column_block2_found = false;
34002
34007 while (current_diag_column_block1 != nullptr &&
34008 current_diag_column_block1 != current_diag_block)
34009 {
34010 if (*current_diag_column_block1->row_index_range ==
34011 *current_trailing_block->row_index_range)
34012 {
34016 is_diag_column_block1_found = true;
34017
34018 break;
34019 }
34020 else if ((*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[0] >=
34021 (*current_diag_column_block1->row_index_range)[1])
34022 {
34026 current_diag_column_block1 =
34027 current_diag_column_block1
34028 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
34029
34030 if (current_diag_column_block1 != nullptr &&
34031 (*current_diag_column_block1->row_index_range)[0] >=
34032 (*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[1])
34033 {
34041 break;
34042 }
34043 }
34044 else if ((*current_diag_column_block1->row_index_range)[0] >=
34045 (*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[1])
34046 {
34050 current_diag_column_block1 =
34051 current_diag_column_block1
34052 ->previous_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
34053
34054 if (current_diag_column_block1 != nullptr &&
34055 current_diag_column_block1 != current_diag_block &&
34056 (*current_trailing_block->row_index_range)[0] >=
34057 (*current_diag_column_block1->row_index_range)[1])
34058 {
34066 break;
34067 }
34068 }
34069 }
34070
34071 if (is_diag_column_block1_found)
34072 {
34078 while (current_diag_column_block2 != nullptr &&
34079 current_diag_column_block2 != current_diag_block)
34080 {
34081 if (*current_diag_column_block2->row_index_range ==
34082 *current_trailing_block->col_index_range)
34083 {
34087 is_diag_column_block2_found = true;
34088
34089 break;
34090 }
34091 else if ((*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
34092 (*current_diag_column_block2
34093 ->row_index_range)[1])
34094 {
34098 current_diag_column_block2 =
34099 current_diag_column_block2
34100 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
34101
34102 if (current_diag_column_block2 != nullptr &&
34103 (*current_diag_column_block2
34104 ->row_index_range)[0] >=
34105 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[1])
34106 {
34114 break;
34115 }
34116 }
34117 else if ((*current_diag_column_block2
34118 ->row_index_range)[0] >=
34119 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[1])
34120 {
34124 current_diag_column_block2 =
34125 current_diag_column_block2
34126 ->previous_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
34127
34128 if (current_diag_column_block2 != nullptr &&
34129 current_diag_column_block2 !=
34130 current_diag_block &&
34131 (*current_trailing_block->col_index_range)[0] >=
34132 (*current_diag_column_block2
34133 ->row_index_range)[1])
34134 {
34142 break;
34143 }
34144 }
34145 }
34146
34147 if (!is_diag_column_block2_found)
34148 {
34154 if (current_diag_column_block2 == nullptr ||
34155 current_diag_column_block2 == current_diag_block)
34156 {
34157 current_diag_column_block2 =
34158 current_diag_block
34159 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
34160 }
34161 }
34162 }
34163 else
34164 {
34170 if (current_diag_column_block1 == nullptr ||
34171 current_diag_column_block1 == current_diag_block)
34172 {
34173 current_diag_column_block1 =
34174 current_diag_block
34175 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
34176 }
34177 }
34178
34184 if (is_diag_column_block1_found && is_diag_column_block2_found)
34185 {
34186 if (current_trailing_block->is_leaf() ||
34187 current_diag_column_block1->is_leaf() ||
34188 current_diag_column_block2->is_leaf())
34189 {
34194 current_trailing_block->cholesky_update_task(
34195 dag,
34196 *current_diag_block,
34197 *current_diag_column_block1,
34198 *current_diag_column_block2,
34199 fixed_rank,
34200 log_stream_lock);
34201
34207 current_diag_column_block1
34208 ->lu_or_cholesky_build_solve_upper_to_update_dependencies(
34209 *current_trailing_block);
34210
34216 current_diag_column_block2
34217 ->lu_or_cholesky_build_solve_upper_to_update_dependencies(
34218 *current_trailing_block);
34219 }
34220 }
34221 }
34222 }
34223 }
34224}

34227template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34228void
34229HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::cholesky_factorize_diagonal_block_task(
34230 tbb::flow::graph &dag,
34231 std::mutex &log_stream_lock)
34232{
34236 Assert(block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
34237 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34238
34239 this->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node = std::make_shared<TaskNode>(
34240 dag, [this, &log_stream_lock](const tbb::flow::continue_msg &msg) {
34241#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 3
34242 {
34243 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(log_stream_lock);
34244
34245 std::cout << std::this_thread::get_id() << "#cholesky_factorize: ["
34246 << (*this->row_index_range)[0] << ","
34247 << (*this->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34248 << (*this->col_index_range)[0] << ","
34249 << (*this->col_index_range)[1] << ")" << std::endl;
34250 }
34251#endif
34252
34253 if (this->is_leaf())
34254 {
34260 Assert(this->type == FullMatrixType,
34261 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(this->type));
34262 Assert(this->fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
34263 Assert(this->fullmatrix->get_property() ==
34264 LAPACKSupport::Property::symmetric,
34265 ExcInvalidLAPACKFullMatrixProperty(
34266 fullmatrix->get_property()));
34267
34272 this->fullmatrix->compute_cholesky_factorization();
34273 }
34274
34275 return msg;
34276 });
34277}

34280template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34281void
34282HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::cholesky_solve_upper_task(
34283 tbb::flow::graph &dag,
34284 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &Z,
34285 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
34286 std::mutex &log_stream_lock)
34287{
34291 Assert(block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
34292 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34293 Assert(Z.block_type != HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
34294 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(Z.block_type));
34295
34300 Assert(!Z.solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node, ExcInternalError());
34301
34302 Z.solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node = std::make_shared<TaskNode>(
34303 dag,
34304 [this, &Z, fixed_rank, &log_stream_lock](
34305 const tbb::flow::continue_msg &msg) {
34306#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 3
34307 {
34308 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(log_stream_lock);
34309
34310 std::cout << std::this_thread::get_id() << "#cholesky_solve_upper: ["
34311 << (*Z.row_index_range)[0] << "," << (*Z.row_index_range)[1]
34312 << "), [" << (*Z.col_index_range)[0] << ","
34313 << (*Z.col_index_range)[1] << ")" << std::endl;
34314 }
34315#endif
34316
34317 this->solve_cholesky_transpose_by_forward_substitution_matrix_valued(
34318 Z, fixed_rank);

34320 });

34323
34324template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34325void
34326HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::cholesky_update_task(
34327 tbb::flow::graph &dag,
34328 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &diag_block,
34329 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &diag_column_block1,
34330 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &diag_column_block2,
34331 const unsigned int fixed_rank,
34332 std::mutex &log_stream_lock)
34333{
34334 this->update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.push_back(
34335 UpdateTaskNodeForLUOrCholesky(
34336 &diag_block,
34337 std::make_shared<TaskNode>(
34338 dag,
34339 [this,
34340 &diag_column_block1,
34341 &diag_column_block2,
34342 fixed_rank,
34343 &log_stream_lock](const tbb::flow::continue_msg &msg) {
34344#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 3
34345 {
34346 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(log_stream_lock);
34347
34348 std::cout << std::this_thread::get_id() << "#cholesky_update: ["
34349 << (*diag_column_block1.row_index_range)[0] << ","
34350 << (*diag_column_block1.row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34351 << (*diag_column_block1.col_index_range)[0] << ","
34352 << (*diag_column_block1.col_index_range)[1] << ") * ["
34353 << (*diag_column_block2.row_index_range)[0] << ","
34354 << (*diag_column_block2.row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34355 << (*diag_column_block2.col_index_range)[0] << ","
34356 << (*diag_column_block2.col_index_range)[1] << ")^T"
34357 << " --> [" << (*this->row_index_range)[0] << ","
34358 << (*this->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34359 << (*this->col_index_range)[0] << ","
34360 << (*this->col_index_range)[1] << ")" << std::endl;
34361 }
34362#endif
34363
34364 diag_column_block1.mTmult_level_conserving_for_parallel_cholesky(
34365 *this,
34366 -1.0,
34367 diag_column_block2,
34368 fixed_rank,
34369 this->property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric);
34370
34371 return msg;
34372 })));
34373}

34376template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34377void
34378HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::cholesky_build_update_to_factorize_dependencies(
34379 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &factorize_block)
34380{
34381 for (auto &update_node : update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes)
34382 {
34383#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
34384 std::cout << "update-to-factorize at level ("
34385 << this->bc_node->get_level() << ","
34386 << factorize_block.bc_node->get_level() << "): ["
34387 << (*this->row_index_range)[0] << ","
34388 << (*this->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34389 << (*this->col_index_range)[0] << ","
34390 << (*this->col_index_range)[1] << ") --> ["
34391 << (*factorize_block.row_index_range)[0] << ","
34392 << (*factorize_block.row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34393 << (*factorize_block.col_index_range)[0] << ","
34394 << (*factorize_block.col_index_range)[1] << ")" << std::endl;
34395#endif
34396
34397 tbb::flow::make_edge(
34398 *update_node.update,
34399 *factorize_block.factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node);
34400 }
34401
34405 for (auto submatrix : submatrices)
34406 {
34407 if (submatrix->block_type !=
34408 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
34409 {
34410 submatrix->cholesky_build_update_to_factorize_dependencies(
34411 factorize_block);
34412 }
34413 }
34414}

34417template <int spacedim, typename Number>

34419HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::cholesky_build_update_to_solve_upper_dependencies(

34421{

34426 {
34427#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
34428 Assert(solve_upper_block.block_type ==
34429 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block,

34431

34433 << this->bc_node->get_level() << ","
34434 << solve_upper_block.bc_node->get_level() << "): ["
34435 << (*update_node.diagonal_hmat_node->row_index_range)[0] << ","
34436 << (*update_node.diagonal_hmat_node->row_index_range)[1]
34437 << "), ["
34438 << (*update_node.diagonal_hmat_node->col_index_range)[0] << ","
34439 << (*update_node.diagonal_hmat_node->col_index_range)[1]
34440 << ") --> [" << (*solve_upper_block.row_index_range)[0] << ","
34441 << (*solve_upper_block.row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34442 << (*solve_upper_block.col_index_range)[0] << ","
34443 << (*solve_upper_block.col_index_range)[1] << ")" << std::endl;
34444#endif
34445
34446 tbb::flow::make_edge(
34447 *update_node.update,
34448 *solve_upper_block.solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node);
34449 }
34450
34454 for (auto submatrix : submatrices)
34455 {
34456 if (submatrix->block_type !=
34457 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
34458 {
34459 submatrix->cholesky_build_update_to_solve_upper_dependencies(
34460 solve_upper_block);

34465
34466template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34467void
34468HMatrix<spacedim,
34469 Number>::cholesky_assign_update_to_solve_and_factorize_dependencies()
34470{
34471 if (solve_upper_or_lower_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node)
34472 {
34477 cholesky_build_update_to_solve_upper_dependencies(*this);
34478
34484 }
34485 else
34486 {
34487 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block)
34488 {
34494 if (factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node)
34495 {
34496 cholesky_build_update_to_factorize_dependencies(*this);
34497
34504 if (parent != nullptr &&
34505 parent->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node &&
34506 // Only when the current matrix block is the last diagonal
34507 // block within its parent matrix, the
34508 // factorization-to-factorization task dependency will be
34509 // created.
34510 submatrix_index == (parent->get_n_row_blocks() - 1) *
34511 (parent->get_n_col_blocks() + 1))
34512 {
34513#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && MESSAGE_LEVEL >= 2
34514 std::cout << "factorize-to-factorize at level ("
34515 << this->bc_node->get_level() << ","
34516 << parent->bc_node->get_level() << "): ["
34517 << (*this->row_index_range)[0] << ","
34518 << (*this->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34519 << (*this->col_index_range)[0] << ","
34520 << (*this->col_index_range)[1] << ") --> ["
34521 << (*parent->row_index_range)[0] << ","
34522 << (*parent->row_index_range)[1] << "), ["
34523 << (*parent->col_index_range)[0] << ","
34524 << (*parent->col_index_range)[1] << ")"
34525 << std::endl;
34526#endif
34527
34528 tbb::flow::make_edge(
34529 *factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node,
34530 *parent->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node);
34531 }
34532 }
34533 }
34534
34540 for (auto submatrix : submatrices)
34541 {
34542 if (submatrix->block_type !=
34543 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
34544 {
34548 if (update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.size() > 0)
34549 {
34550 submatrix->update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.insert(
34551 submatrix->update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.end(),
34552 update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.begin(),
34553 update_lu_or_cholesky_graph_nodes.end());
34554 }
34555
34556 submatrix
34557 ->cholesky_assign_update_to_solve_and_factorize_dependencies();
34558 }
34559 }
34560 }
34561}

34563
34564template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34565double
34566HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_near_field_hmat_vmult_or_Tvmult_task_cost(
34567 const HMatrixSupport::Property top_hmat_property) const
34568{
34569 Assert(type == HMatrixType::FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
34570 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
34571
34572 switch (top_hmat_property)
34573 {
34574 case HMatrixSupport::Property::general: {
34575 return m * n;
34576 }
34577 case HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric:
34578 case HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric: {
34579 switch (block_type)
34580 {
34581 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
34582 return m * n;
34583 }
34584 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
34585 return 2 * m * n;
34586 }
34587 default: {
34588 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34589
34590 return 0;
34591 }
34592 }
34593 }
34594 case HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular: {
34595 switch (block_type)
34596 {
34597 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
34598 return m * n / 2.0;
34599 }
34600 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
34601 return m * n;
34602 }
34603 default: {
34604 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34605
34606 return 0;
34607 }
34608 }
34609 }
34610 case HMatrixSupport::Property::upper_triangular: {
34611 switch (block_type)
34612 {
34613 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
34614 return m * n / 2.0;
34615 }
34616 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
34617 return m * n;
34618 }
34619 default: {
34620 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34621
34622 return 0;
34623 }
34624 }
34625 }
34626 default: {
34627 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(top_hmat_property));
34628
34629 return 0;
34630 }
34631 }
34632}
34633
34634
34635template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34636double
34637HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_far_field_hmat_vmult_or_Tvmult_task_cost(
34638 const HMatrixSupport::Property top_hmat_property) const
34639{
34640 Assert(type == HMatrixType::RkMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
34641 Assert(rkmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
34642
34643 switch (top_hmat_property)
34644 {
34645 case HMatrixSupport::Property::general: {
34646 return rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34647 }
34648 case HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric:
34649 case HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric: {
34650 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
34651 {
34652 return 2 * rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34653 }
34654 else
34655 {
34656 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34657
34658 return 0;
34659 }
34660 }
34661 case HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular: {
34662 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
34663 {
34664 return rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34665 }
34666 else
34667 {
34668 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34669
34670 return 0;
34671 }
34672 }
34673 case HMatrixSupport::Property::upper_triangular: {
34674 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
34675 {
34676 return rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34677 }
34678 else
34679 {
34680 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34681
34682 return 0;
34683 }
34684 }
34685 default: {
34686 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(top_hmat_property));
34687
34688 return 0;
34689 }
34690 }
34691}
34692
34693
34694template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34695void
34696HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_leaf_set_vmult_or_Tvmult_task_costs(
34697 std::vector<double> &task_costs) const
34698{
34699 AssertDimension(leaf_set.size(), task_costs.size());
34700
34701 unsigned int i = 0;
34702 for (const auto hmat : leaf_set)
34703 {
34704 switch (hmat->type)
34705 {
34706 case HMatrixType::FullMatrixType: {
34707 task_costs[i] =
34708 hmat->compute_near_field_hmat_vmult_or_Tvmult_task_cost(
34709 property);
34710
34711 break;
34712 }
34713 case HMatrixType::RkMatrixType: {
34714 task_costs[i] =
34715 hmat->compute_far_field_hmat_vmult_or_Tvmult_task_cost(
34716 property);
34717
34718 break;
34719 }
34720 default: {
34721 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(hmat->type));
34722 task_costs[i] = 0;
34723
34724 break;
34725 }
34726 }
34727
34728 i++;
34729 }
34730}
34731
34732
34733template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34734double
34735HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_near_field_hmat_assembly_task_cost(
34736 const HMatrixSupport::Property top_hmat_property) const
34737{
34738 Assert(type == HMatrixType::FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
34739 Assert(fullmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
34740
34741 switch (top_hmat_property)
34742 {
34743 case HMatrixSupport::Property::general: {
34744 return m * n;
34745 }
34746 case HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric:
34747 case HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric:
34748 case HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular: {
34749 switch (block_type)
34750 {
34751 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
34752 return m * n / 2.0 + m / 2.0;
34753 }
34754 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
34755 return m * n;
34756 }
34757 default: {
34758 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34759
34760 return 0;
34761 }
34762 }
34763 }
34764 case HMatrixSupport::Property::upper_triangular: {
34765 switch (block_type)
34766 {
34767 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
34768 return m * n / 2.0 + m / 2.0;
34769 }
34770 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
34771 return m * n;
34772 }
34773 default: {
34774 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34775
34776 return 0;
34777 }
34778 }
34779 }
34780 default: {
34781 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(top_hmat_property));
34782
34783 return 0;
34784 }
34785 }
34786}
34787
34788
34789template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34790void
34791HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_near_field_leaf_set_assembly_task_costs(
34792 std::vector<double> &task_costs) const
34793{
34794 AssertDimension(near_field_leaf_set.size(), task_costs.size());
34795
34796 unsigned int i = 0;
34797 for (const auto hmat : near_field_leaf_set)
34798 {
34799 Assert(hmat->type == HMatrixType::FullMatrixType,
34800 ExcInvalidHMatrixType(hmat->type));
34801 task_costs[i] =
34802 hmat->compute_near_field_hmat_assembly_task_cost(property);
34803
34804 i++;
34805 }
34806}
34807
34808
34809template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34810double
34811HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_far_field_hmat_assembly_task_cost(
34812 const HMatrixSupport::Property top_hmat_property) const
34813{
34814 Assert(type == HMatrixType::RkMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
34815 Assert(rkmatrix != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
34816
34821 switch (top_hmat_property)
34822 {
34823 case HMatrixSupport::Property::general: {
34824 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block ||
34825 block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
34826 {
34827 return rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34828 }
34829 else
34830 {
34831 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34832
34833 return 0;
34834 }
34835 }
34836 case HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric:
34837 case HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric:
34838 case HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular: {
34839 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
34840 {
34841 return rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34842 }
34843 else
34844 {
34845 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34846
34847 return 0;
34848 }
34849 }
34850 case HMatrixSupport::Property::upper_triangular: {
34851 if (block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
34852 {
34853 return rkmatrix->get_formal_rank() * (m + n);
34854 }
34855 else
34856 {
34857 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
34858
34859 return 0;
34860 }
34861 }
34862 default: {
34863 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(top_hmat_property));
34864
34865 return 0;
34866 }
34867 }
34868}

34871template <int spacedim, typename Number>

34873HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_far_field_leaf_set_assembly_task_costs(
34874 std::vector<double> &task_costs) const

34890template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34891void
34892HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::get_row_index_range_for_leaf_set_interval(
34893 const std::pair<int64_t, int64_t> &interval,
34894 const unsigned int thread_no)
34895{
34896 Assert(interval.second >= interval.first, ExcInternalError());
34897
34898 const unsigned int hmat_num = interval.second - interval.first + 1;
34899 std::vector<types::global_dof_index> index_range_lower_bound(hmat_num);
34900 std::vector<types::global_dof_index> index_range_upper_bound(hmat_num);
34901
34902 for (unsigned int i = interval.first; i <= interval.second; i++)
34903 {
34904 index_range_lower_bound[i - interval.first] =
34905 (*leaf_set[i]->row_index_range)[0];
34906 index_range_upper_bound[i - interval.first] =
34907 (*leaf_set[i]->row_index_range)[1];
34908 }
34909
34914 typename std::vector<types::global_dof_index>::iterator min_it =
34915 std::min_element(index_range_lower_bound.begin(),
34916 index_range_lower_bound.end());
34917 typename std::vector<types::global_dof_index>::iterator max_it =
34918 std::max_element(index_range_upper_bound.begin(),
34919 index_range_upper_bound.end());
34920
34921 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
34922 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0] = *min_it;
34923 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
34924 .local_vmult_result_index_range[1] = *max_it;
34925
34926 Assert((*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
34927 .local_vmult_result_index_range[1] >
34928 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
34929 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0],
34930 ExcInternalError());
34931}

34978template <int spacedim, typename Number>
34979void
34980HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::
34981 compute_vmult_contributing_index_ranges_from_all_threads(
34982 const unsigned int thread_no)
34983{
34984 const unsigned int thread_num = data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads->size();
34985
34986 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
34987 .vmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads.clear();
34988 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
34989 .vmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads.resize(
34990 thread_num);
34991

34993
34994 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
34995 {
34996 intersect(
34997 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no].vmult_result_index_range,
34998 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[i].local_vmult_result_index_range,
34999 range_intersection);
35000
35001 (*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35002 .vmult_result_index_ranges_contributed_from_other_threads[i] =
35003 range_intersection;
35004 }

35039template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35040unsigned int
35041HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_vmult_or_tvmult_thread_num(
35042 const bool is_vmult,
35043 const bool is_tvmult) const
35044{
35049 unsigned int thread_num =
35050 std::min(static_cast<size_t>(MultithreadInfo::n_threads()),
35051 leaf_set.size());
35052
35058 if (is_vmult)
35059 {
35060 if (this->m < thread_num)
35061 {
35062 thread_num = this->m;
35063 }
35064 }
35065
35071 if (is_tvmult)
35072 {
35073 if (this->n < thread_num)
35074 {
35075 thread_num = this->n;
35076 }
35077 }
35078
35079 return thread_num;
35080}
35081
35082
35083template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35084void
35085HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::prepare_for_vmult_or_tvmult(const bool is_vmult,
35086 const bool is_tvmult)
35087{
35091 Assert(parent == nullptr, ExcInternalError());
35092
35093 const unsigned int thread_num =
35094 compute_vmult_or_tvmult_thread_num(is_vmult, is_tvmult);
35095
35100 if (thread_num > 1)
35101 {
35102 data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads =
35103 std::make_unique<std::vector<VmultOrTvmultThreadData>>(thread_num);
35104
35108 std::vector<double> task_costs(leaf_set.size());
35109 this->compute_leaf_set_vmult_or_Tvmult_task_costs(task_costs);
35110
35114 auto cost_func = [&task_costs](int i, int j) -> double {
35115 double sum = 0.0;
35116
35117 for (int k = i; k <= j; k++)
35118 {
35119 sum += task_costs[k];
35120 }
35121
35122 return sum;
35123 };
35124
35125 SequencePartitioner<decltype(cost_func)> sp(task_costs.size(),
35126 thread_num,
35127 cost_func);
35128 sp.partition();
35129
35130 std::vector<std::pair<int64_t, int64_t>> leaf_set_intervals;
35131 sp.get_partitions(leaf_set_intervals);
35132
35133 auto prepare_thread_self_data =
35134 [this,
35135 thread_num,
35136 is_vmult,
35137 is_tvmult](const std::pair<int64_t, int64_t> &interval,
35138 const unsigned int thread_no) -> void {
35139 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no].leaf_set_interval =
35140 interval;
35141
35142 if (is_vmult)
35143 {
35147 this->get_row_index_range_for_leaf_set_interval(interval,
35148 thread_no);
35149
35153 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35154 .local_vmult_result.reinit(
35155 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35156 .local_vmult_result_index_range[1] -
35157 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35158 .local_vmult_result_index_range[0]);
35159
35164 types::global_dof_index vmult_result_vector_size =
35165 this->m / thread_num;
35166 Assert(vmult_result_vector_size > 0, ExcInternalError());
35167
35168 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35169 .vmult_result_index_range[0] =
35170 thread_no * vmult_result_vector_size;
35171 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35172 .vmult_result_index_range[1] =
35173 thread_no == thread_num - 1 ?
35174 m :
35175 (thread_no + 1) * vmult_result_vector_size;
35176 }
35177
35178 if (is_tvmult)
35179 {
35183 this->get_column_index_range_for_leaf_set_interval(interval,
35184 thread_no);
35185
35189 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35190 .local_tvmult_result.reinit(
35191 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35192 .local_tvmult_result_index_range[1] -
35193 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35194 .local_tvmult_result_index_range[0]);
35195
35200 types::global_dof_index tvmult_result_vector_size =
35201 this->n / thread_num;
35202 Assert(tvmult_result_vector_size > 0, ExcInternalError());
35203
35204 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35205 .tvmult_result_index_range[0] =
35206 thread_no * tvmult_result_vector_size;
35207 (*this->data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads)[thread_no]
35208 .tvmult_result_index_range[1] =
35209 thread_no == thread_num - 1 ?
35210 n :
35211 (thread_no + 1) * tvmult_result_vector_size;
35212 }
35213 };
35214
35215 Threads::TaskGroup<void> thread_self_preparation_tasks;
35216 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
35217 {
35218 thread_self_preparation_tasks += Threads::new_task(
35219 std::bind(prepare_thread_self_data, leaf_set_intervals[i], i));
35220 }
35221
35222 thread_self_preparation_tasks.join_all();
35223
35224 auto prepare_thread_mutual_data =
35225 [this, is_vmult, is_tvmult](const unsigned int thread_no) -> void {
35226 if (is_vmult)
35227 {
35232 this->compute_vmult_contributing_index_ranges_from_all_threads(
35233 thread_no);
35234 }
35235
35236 if (is_tvmult)
35237 {
35242 this->compute_tvmult_contributing_index_ranges_from_all_threads(
35243 thread_no);
35244 }
35245 };
35246
35247 Threads::TaskGroup<void> thread_mutual_preparation_tasks;
35248 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < thread_num; i++)
35249 {
35250 thread_mutual_preparation_tasks +=
35251 Threads::new_task(std::bind(prepare_thread_mutual_data, i));
35252 }
35253
35254 thread_mutual_preparation_tasks.join_all();
35255 }
35256 else
35257 {
35258 // Fallback to the serial recursive mode.
35259 this->set_vmult_strategy(
35260 std::make_unique<HMatrixVmultSerialRecursive<spacedim, Number>>());
35261 }
35262}
35263
35264
35265template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35266void
35267HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::compute_cholesky_factorization_task_parallel(
35268 const unsigned int fixed_rank)
35269{
35270 // Set OpenBLAS num threads to 1 when task parallelization is used.
35271 const int blas_num_threads = openblas_get_num_threads();
35272 openblas_set_num_threads(1);
35273
35274#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35275 Timer timer;
35276#endif
35280 this->link_hmat_nodes_on_cross_from_diagonal_blocks(this->property);
35281#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35282 timer.stop();
35283 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "link H-matrix nodes");
35284#endif
35285
35289 std::mutex log_stream_lock;
35290
35294 tbb::flow::graph dag;
35295
35296#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35297 timer.start();
35298#endif
35299 compute_cholesky_dag(dag, fixed_rank, log_stream_lock);
35300#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35301 timer.stop();
35302 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "compute dag");
35303#endif
35304
35305#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35306 timer.start();
35307#endif
35308 cholesky_assign_update_to_solve_and_factorize_dependencies();
35309#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35310 timer.stop();
35311 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "contribute update");
35312#endif
35313
35318 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *top_left_node = this->get_top_left_leaf_node();
35319 Assert(top_left_node != nullptr, ExcInternalError());
35320 Assert(top_left_node->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node,
35321 ExcInternalError());
35322
35323#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35324 timer.start();
35325#endif
35326 top_left_node->factorize_lu_or_cholesky_graph_node->try_put(
35327 tbb::flow::continue_msg());
35328
35329 dag.wait_for_all();
35330#if ENABLE_DEBUG == 1 && ENABLE_TIMER == 1
35331 timer.stop();
35332 print_wall_time(std::cout, timer, "compute cholesky");
35333#endif
35334 clear_lu_or_cholesky_task_nodes();
35335
35340 this->set_state(HMatrixSupport::cholesky);
35341 this->set_property(HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular);
35342
35343 // Restore the original OpenBLAS num threads.
35344 openblas_set_num_threads(blas_num_threads);
35345}

35347
35348template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35349void
35350HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_lu(Vector<Number> &x,
35351 const Vector<Number> &b) const
35352{
35353 Assert(state == HMatrixSupport::lu, ExcInvalidHMatrixState(state));
35354
35355 x = b;
35356 // @p L has unit diagonal.
35357 solve_by_forward_substitution(x, true);
35358 // @p U has non-unit diagonal.
35359 solve_by_backward_substitution(x, false);
35360}

35362
35363template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35364void
35365HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::solve_cholesky(Vector<Number> &x,
35366 const Vector<Number> &b) const
35367{
35368 Assert(state == HMatrixSupport::cholesky,
35369 ExcMessage(std::string("Invalid H-matrix state: ") +
35370 std::string(HMatrixSupport::state_name(state))));
35371
35372 x = b;
35373 solve_cholesky_by_forward_substitution(x);
35374 solve_cholesky_by_backward_substitution(x);
35375}

35377
35378template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35379void
35380HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::_invert_by_gauss_elim(
35381 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> &M_inv,
35382 const size_type fixed_rank_k)
35383{
35384 AssertDimension(m, n);
35385
35398 if (*(bc_node->get_data_reference().get_tau_node()) ==
35399 *(bc_node->get_data_reference().get_sigma_node()) &&
35400 bc_node->is_leaf())
35401 {
35402 Assert(type == FullMatrixType, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(type));
35403
35404 this->fullmatrix->invert_by_gauss_elim(*(M_inv.fullmatrix));
35405 }
35406 else
35407 {
35408 AssertDimension(get_n_row_blocks(), get_n_col_blocks());
35409
35414 const size_type k = get_n_col_blocks();
35415
35419 for (size_type l = 0; l < k; l++)
35420 {
35446 const size_type diag_block_index_in_submatrices = l + l * k;
35447 submatrices[diag_block_index_in_submatrices]->_invert_by_gauss_elim(
35448 *(M_inv.submatrices[diag_block_index_in_submatrices]),
35449 fixed_rank_k);
35450
35459 for (size_type j = l + 1; j < k; j++)
35460 {
35461 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *C =
35462 new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>(submatrices[j + l * k]->bc_node,
35463 fixed_rank_k);
35464 M_inv.submatrices[diag_block_index_in_submatrices]
35465 ->mmult_level_conserving(*C,
35466 *(submatrices[j + l * k]),
35467 fixed_rank_k);
35468
35472 *(submatrices[j + l * k]) = std::move(*C);
35473
35474 delete C;
35475 }
35476
35482 for (size_type j = 0; j < l; j++)
35483 {
35484 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *C = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>(
35485 M_inv.submatrices[j + l * k]->bc_node, fixed_rank_k);
35486 M_inv.submatrices[diag_block_index_in_submatrices]
35487 ->mmult_level_conserving(*C,
35488 *(M_inv.submatrices[j + l * k]),
35489 fixed_rank_k);
35490
35494 *(M_inv.submatrices[j + l * k]) = std::move(*C);
35495
35496 delete C;
35497 }
35498
35504 for (size_type i = l + 1; i < k; i++)
35505 {
35506 for (size_type j = 0; j <= l; j++)
35507 {
35508 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *C = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>(
35509 M_inv.submatrices[j + i * k]->bc_node, fixed_rank_k);
35510 submatrices[l + i * k]->mmult_level_conserving(
35511 *C, *(M_inv.submatrices[j + l * k]), fixed_rank_k);
35512 M_inv.submatrices[j + i * k]->add(-1.0, *C, fixed_rank_k);
35513
35514 delete C;
35515 }
35516
35517 for (size_type j = l + 1; j < k; j++)
35518 {
35519 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *C = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>(
35520 submatrices[j + i * k]->bc_node, fixed_rank_k);
35521 submatrices[l + i * k]->mmult_level_conserving(
35522 *C, *(submatrices[j + l * k]), fixed_rank_k);
35523 submatrices[j + i * k]->add(-1.0, *C, fixed_rank_k);
35524
35525 delete C;
35526 }
35527 }
35528 }
35529
35533 for (size_type l = k - 1; l > 0; l--)
35534 {
35538 size_type i = l - 1;
35539 while (true)
35540 {
35541 for (size_type j = 0; j < k; j++)
35542 {
35543 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *C = new HMatrix<spacedim, Number>(
35544 M_inv.submatrices[j + i * k]->bc_node, fixed_rank_k);
35545 submatrices[l + i * k]->mmult_level_conserving(
35546 *C, *(M_inv.submatrices[j + l * k]), fixed_rank_k);
35547 M_inv.submatrices[j + i * k]->add(-1.0, *C, fixed_rank_k);
35548
35549 delete C;
35550 }
35551
35552 if (i == 0)
35553 {
35554 break;
35555 }
35556 else
35557 {
35558 i--;
35559 }
35560 }
35561 }
35562 }
35563}
35564
35565
35566template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35567void
35568HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::coarsen_to_subtree(
35569 const BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &subtree,
35570 const unsigned int fixed_rank_k)
35571{
35572 coarsen_to_partition(subtree.get_leaf_set(), fixed_rank_k);
35573 build_leaf_set();
35574 link_hmat_nodes_on_same_levels();
35575}

35577
35578template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35579void
35580HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::coarsen_to_partition(
35581 const std::vector<
35582 typename BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type>::node_pointer_type>
35583 &partition,
35584 const unsigned int fixed_rank_k)
35585{
35593 if (find_pointer_data(partition.begin(), partition.end(), this->bc_node) !=
35594 partition.end())
35595 {
35601 convertHMatBlockToRkMatrix(this, fixed_rank_k);
35602 }
35603 else
35604 {
35610 for (HMatrix *submatrix : submatrices)
35611 {
35612 submatrix->coarsen_to_partition(partition, fixed_rank_k);
35613 }
35614 }
35615}

35617
35618template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35619void
35620HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::link_hmat_nodes_on_same_levels()
35621{
35622 const HMatrixSupport::Property top_hmat_property = this->property;
35623
35624 std::queue<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *> work_queue;
35625
35626 if (submatrices.size() > 0)
35627 {
35628 work_queue.push(this);
35629
35630 while (!work_queue.empty())
35631 {
35632 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_hmat_node = work_queue.front();
35633 work_queue.pop();
35634
35639 if (work_queue.size() > 0)
35640 {
35641 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *next_hmat_node = work_queue.front();
35642 if (current_hmat_node->bc_node->get_level() ==
35643 next_hmat_node->bc_node->get_level())
35644 {
35645 current_hmat_node->next_same_level_hmat_node = next_hmat_node;
35646 }
35647 else
35648 {
35649 current_hmat_node->next_same_level_hmat_node = nullptr;
35650 }
35651 }
35652 else
35653 {
35654 current_hmat_node->next_same_level_hmat_node = nullptr;
35655 }
35656
35660 for (auto hmat : current_hmat_node->submatrices)
35661 {
35662 switch (top_hmat_property)
35663 {
35664 case HMatrixSupport::Property::general:
35665 work_queue.push(hmat);
35666
35667 break;
35668 case HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric:
35669 case HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric:
35670 case HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular:
35671 if (hmat->block_type ==
35672 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block ||
35673 hmat->block_type ==
35674 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block)
35675 {
35676 work_queue.push(hmat);
35677 }
35678
35679 break;
35680 case HMatrixSupport::Property::upper_triangular:
35681 if (hmat->block_type ==
35682 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block ||
35683 hmat->block_type ==
35684 HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block)
35685 {
35686 work_queue.push(hmat);
35687 }
35688
35689 break;
35690 default:
35691 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(top_hmat_property));
35692
35693 break;
35694 }
35695 }
35696 }
35697 }
35698}
35699
35700
35701template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35702void
35703HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::link_hmat_nodes_on_cross_from_diagonal_blocks(
35704 const HMatrixSupport::Property top_hmat_property)
35705{
35706 Assert(block_type == HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block,
35707 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(block_type));
35708
35713 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_hmat_node_on_same_row = this;
35714 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_hmat_node_on_same_column = this;
35715
35716 this->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node = nullptr;
35717 this->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node = nullptr;
35718 this->previous_same_level_same_row_hmat_node = nullptr;
35719 this->previous_same_level_same_column_hmat_node = nullptr;
35720
35721 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *current_hmat_node_on_same_level =
35722 this->next_same_level_hmat_node;
35723
35724 while (current_hmat_node_on_same_level != nullptr)
35725 {
35731 if (top_hmat_property == HMatrixSupport::Property::general ||
35732 top_hmat_property == HMatrixSupport::Property::upper_triangular)
35733 {
35738 if (*current_hmat_node_on_same_level->row_index_range ==
35739 *this->row_index_range)
35740 {
35746 Assert((*current_hmat_node_on_same_level->col_index_range)[0] >=
35747 (*this->col_index_range)[1],
35748 ExcInternalError());
35749
35750 current_hmat_node_on_same_row
35751 ->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node =
35752 current_hmat_node_on_same_level;
35753 current_hmat_node_on_same_level
35754 ->previous_same_level_same_row_hmat_node =
35755 current_hmat_node_on_same_row;
35756
35760 current_hmat_node_on_same_row =
35761 current_hmat_node_on_same_row
35762 ->next_same_level_same_row_hmat_node;
35763 }
35764 }
35765
35771 if (top_hmat_property == HMatrixSupport::Property::general ||
35772 top_hmat_property == HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric ||
35773 top_hmat_property == HMatrixSupport::Property::hermite_symmetric ||
35774 top_hmat_property == HMatrixSupport::Property::lower_triangular)
35775 {
35780 if (*current_hmat_node_on_same_level->col_index_range ==
35781 *this->col_index_range)
35782 {
35788 Assert((*current_hmat_node_on_same_level->row_index_range)[0] >=
35789 (*this->row_index_range)[1],
35790 ExcInternalError());
35791
35792 current_hmat_node_on_same_column
35793 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node =
35794 current_hmat_node_on_same_level;
35795 current_hmat_node_on_same_level
35796 ->previous_same_level_same_column_hmat_node =
35797 current_hmat_node_on_same_column;
35798
35802 current_hmat_node_on_same_column =
35803 current_hmat_node_on_same_column
35804 ->next_same_level_same_column_hmat_node;
35805 }
35806 }
35807
35811 current_hmat_node_on_same_level =
35812 current_hmat_node_on_same_level->next_same_level_hmat_node;
35813 }
35814
35818 if (submatrices.size() > 0)
35819 {
35820 const unsigned int n_row_blocks = get_n_row_blocks();
35821 const unsigned int n_col_blocks = get_n_col_blocks();
35822
35823 for (size_type i = 0; i < n_row_blocks; i++)
35824 {
35825 submatrices[i * n_col_blocks + i]
35826 ->link_hmat_nodes_on_cross_from_diagonal_blocks(top_hmat_property);
35827 }
35828 }
35829}

35868template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35869void
35870HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::build_leaf_set()
35871{
35872 leaf_set.clear();
35873 near_field_leaf_set.clear();
35874 far_field_leaf_set.clear();
35875
35876 switch (HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::leaf_set_traversal_method)
35877 {
35878 case SpaceFillingCurveType::Z: {
35879 _build_leaf_set_z_traversal(leaf_set,
35880 near_field_leaf_set,
35881 far_field_leaf_set,
35882 property);
35883
35884 break;
35885 }
35886 case SpaceFillingCurveType::Hilbert: {
35890 _build_leaf_set_hilbert_traversal(leaf_set,
35891 near_field_leaf_set,
35892 far_field_leaf_set,
35893 HilbertBlockType::A,
35894 property);
35895
35896 break;
35897 }
35898 }
35899}

35981template <int spacedim, typename Number>
35982typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>::iterator
35983HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::find_block_cluster_in_leaf_set(
35984 const BlockCluster<spacedim, real_type> &block_cluster)
35985{
35986 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>::iterator iter;
35987 for (iter = leaf_set.begin(); iter != leaf_set.end(); iter++)
35988 {
36001 if ((*iter)->bc_node != nullptr)
36002 {
36003 if ((*iter)->bc_node->get_data_reference() == block_cluster)
36004 {
36005 break;
36006 }
36007 }
36008 }
36009
36010 return iter;
36011}

36014template <int spacedim, typename Number>

36016HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::find_block_cluster_in_leaf_set(
36017 const BlockCluster<spacedim, real_type> &block_cluster) const
36018{

36020 leaf_set.cbegin();
36021 iter != leaf_set.cend();
36022 iter++)
36023 {
36036 if ((*iter)->bc_node != nullptr)
36037 {
36038 if ((*iter)->bc_node->get_data_reference() == block_cluster)

36046
36047template <int spacedim, typename Number>
36048void
36049HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::refine_to_supertree()
36050{
36060 for (HMatrix *hmat_leaf_node : leaf_set)
36061 {
36065 RefineHMatrixWrtExtendedBlockClusterTree(hmat_leaf_node, hmat_leaf_node);
36066
36071 if (hmat_leaf_node->submatrices.size() > 0)
36072 {
36080 switch (hmat_leaf_node->type)
36081 {
36082 case FullMatrixType: {
36083 delete hmat_leaf_node->fullmatrix;
36084 hmat_leaf_node->fullmatrix = nullptr;
36085
36086 break;
36087 }
36088 case RkMatrixType: {
36089 delete hmat_leaf_node->rkmatrix;
36090 hmat_leaf_node->rkmatrix = nullptr;
36091
36092 break;
36093 }
36094 default: {
36095 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(hmat_leaf_node->type));
36096
36097 break;
36098 }
36099 }
36100
36101 hmat_leaf_node->type = HierarchicalMatrixType;
36102 }
36103 }
36104
36110 build_leaf_set();
36111 link_hmat_nodes_on_same_levels();
36112
36117}

36120template <int spacedim, typename Number>
36121void
36122HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::convert_between_different_block_cluster_trees(
36123 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct1,
36124 BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type> &bct2,
36125 const unsigned int fixed_rank_k2)
36126{
36131 std::vector<typename BlockClusterTree<spacedim, real_type>::node_pointer_type>
36132 target_leaf_set(bct2.get_leaf_set());
36133
36142 if (bct1.extend_finer_than_partition(target_leaf_set))
36143 {
36144 this->refine_to_supertree();
36145 }
36146
36152 bool is_bct2_extended = bct2.extend_to_finer_partition(bct1.get_leaf_set());
36153
36173 HMatrix<spacedim, Number> hmat_new(bct2, std::move(*this));
36174
36175 if (is_bct2_extended)
36176 {
36181 hmat_new.coarsen_to_partition(target_leaf_set, fixed_rank_k2);
36182 hmat_new.build_leaf_set();
36183 hmat_new.link_hmat_nodes_on_same_levels();
36184
36191 // std::ofstream out1("target_bct_with_extension.dat");
36192 // bct2.write_leaf_set(out1);
36193 // out1.close();
36194 // std::cout << "=== bct2 with extension ===\n";
36195 // std::cout << "Number of nodes: " << bct2.get_node_num()
36196 // << "\nDepth: " << bct2.get_depth()
36197 // << "\nMax level: " << bct2.get_max_level() <<
36198 // std::endl;
36199 bct2.prune_to_partition(target_leaf_set, true);
36200 // std::ofstream out2("target_bct_after_pruning.dat");
36201 // bct2.write_leaf_set(out2);
36202 // out2.close();
36203 // std::cout << "=== bct2 after pruning ===\n";
36204 // std::cout << "Number of nodes: " << bct2.get_node_num()
36205 // << "\nDepth: " << bct2.get_depth()
36206 // << "\nMax level: " << bct2.get_max_level() <<
36207 // std::endl;
36208 }
36209
36214 (*this) = std::move(hmat_new);
36215}

36222 const HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *M2)
36223{

36257
36258template <int spacedim, typename Number>
36259TreeNodeSplitMode
36260HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::determine_mm_split_mode_from_Sigma_P()
36261{
36262 TreeNodeSplitMode initial_split_mode, current_split_mode;
36263
36264 size_type counter = 0;
36265 for (const std::pair<HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *, HMatrix<spacedim, Number> *>
36266 &hmat_pair : Sigma_P)
36267 {
36268 if ((hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == HorizontalSplitMode &&
36269 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == UnsplitMode) ||
36270 (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode &&
36271 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == HorizontalSplitMode))
36272 {
36273 current_split_mode = HorizontalSplitMode;
36274 }
36275 else if ((hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == UnsplitMode &&
36276 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
36277 VerticalSplitMode) ||
36278 (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
36279 VerticalSplitMode &&
36280 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode))
36281 {
36282 current_split_mode = VerticalSplitMode;
36283 }
36284 else if ((hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() == CrossSplitMode &&
36285 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
36286 CrossSplitMode) ||
36287 (hmat_pair.first->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
36288 HorizontalSplitMode &&
36289 hmat_pair.second->bc_node->get_split_mode() ==
36290 VerticalSplitMode))
36291 {
36292 current_split_mode = CrossSplitMode;
36293 }
36294 else
36295 {
36296 Assert(false,
36297 ExcMessage(
36298 "Inconsistent case met during H-matrix MM multiplication"));
36299 }
36300
36301 if (counter == 0)
36302 {
36303 initial_split_mode = current_split_mode;
36304 }
36305 else if (current_split_mode != initial_split_mode)
36306 {
36307 Assert(false,
36308 ExcMessage(
36309 "Inconsistent case met during H-matrix MM multiplication"));
36310 }
36311
36312 counter++;
36313 }
36314
36315 return initial_split_mode;
36316}
36317
36318template <int spacedim, typename Number>
36319std::size_t
36320HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::memory_consumption_of_current_hmat_node() const
36321{
36322 std::size_t memory_for_hmat_node = 0;
36323
36328 if (type == FullMatrixType)
36329 {
36330 memory_for_hmat_node += this->fullmatrix->memory_consumption();
36331 }
36332 else if (type == RkMatrixType)
36333 {
36334 memory_for_hmat_node += this->rkmatrix->memory_consumption();
36335 }
36336
36340 memory_for_hmat_node +=
36341 sizeof(*this) +
36342 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(leaf_set) - sizeof(leaf_set)) +
36343 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(submatrices) - sizeof(submatrices)) +
36344 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(near_field_leaf_set) -
36345 sizeof(near_field_leaf_set)) +
36346 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(far_field_leaf_set) -
36347 sizeof(far_field_leaf_set)) +
36348 (Tind.memory_consumption() - sizeof(Tind)) +
36349 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(Sigma_P) - sizeof(Sigma_P)) +
36350 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(Sigma_R) - sizeof(Sigma_R)) +
36351 (MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(Sigma_F) - sizeof(Sigma_F)) +
36352 sizeof(data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads);
36353
36354 if (data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads != nullptr)
36355 memory_for_hmat_node +=
36356 MemoryConsumption::memory_consumption(*data_for_vmult_or_tvmult_threads);
36357
36358 return memory_for_hmat_node;
36359}
36360
36361
36362template <int spacedim, typename Number>
36363std::size_t
36364HMatrix<spacedim, Number>::memory_consumption() const
36365{
36366 std::size_t total_memory = 0;
36367
36368 total_memory += memory_consumption_of_current_hmat_node();
36369
36370 for (auto submatrix : submatrices)
36371 {
36372 total_memory += submatrix->memory_consumption();
36373 }
36374
36375 return total_memory;
36376}
